tei:div.tei:p: 1) ༄༅/ thugs dam nar ma nang gi nyams bzhes kyi yig chung gabs pa snying gi rgya can gyi u pa de sha bzhugs so// 2) rdze btsun bla ma dmigs pa mod pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa'i zhabs kyi padmor sgo gsum gus pa chen pos dus rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ thog med dus nas drin gyis bskyang ba'i 'gro/ gang thugs dmigs mod brtse bas rjed 'dzin zhing*/ rlabs chen rgyal sras rgyal ba'i 'khor los bsgyur/ mtshungs med dpal mgon bla mas bdag skyongs shig ma rig gzung 'dzin 3)nang gi mun pa'i khams/ nyi zla sgron me snang ba mi brdzi ba/ mkhyen rab ye shes ral gri'i 'khrul 'khor gyis/ mod la 'jom mdzad 'jam pa'i dbyangs la 'dud/ mdang ldan dri med utpal lang tsho la/ rjes chags g.yo ba'i gags bsgyur padma 'byung*/ 'anum phrag mkha' 'gro'i sprin phung dang bces pa/ mthon mthing ral pa'i cod paṇa rtse ru bzhugs/ sngon byon mkhas dang grub pa'i tshogs mang po'i/ zhal nas snyan brgyud thugs kyi gdams pa'i bcud/ nyams 4)len gnad kyi gal mod cung zad zhig legs par zhu nas thugs la gsan par rigs/ deng sang dus kyi snyigs ma'i chos gzugs rnams/ dam pa brten gdams bcud ma lon par/ mi tshe ri la stongs zad skyel ba mthong*/ de 'dra'i lad mo ma byed snying gi bu/ dge bshes 'ban gyis jo bo'i man ngag gi/ 'chi ba mi rtag skyabs 'gro'i nyams len gnyis/ thugs la bltar bas sku tshe de nyid la/ mkha' spyod grub nas 'od lus yal ba yin/ nyams len gnad khrol gyi ling sgrog bkrol bzhin/ man ngag lag len khog dkrol ma shes na/ sems 'dzin gtad po'i mdung tshugs cig 5)pu la/ re ba che bas sa lam yon tan med/ de phyir nyid ni chos la thugs gzhol zhing*/ brtson 'grus mi dal nyams len byed pa la/ yang dag lam gyi mngon rtogs bskyed pa la/ 'di tsam dgos pa'i gnad du rigs byas nas/ dpe la ma bzhag sems dang 'dres pas mdzod/

sngon gom dge ba'i bag chags dkar po tshe 'dir smin pas/ bdag po dang 'khor 'dabs kyis brel ba'i dge ba'i bar chad dang bral zhing*/ phyi'i rkyen bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pas thugs brtse bas rjes su bzung zhing*/ nang gi rkyen dad pa dang mos gus che zhing shes rab chen pos gdams pa'i 6)bcud 'dzin zhing*/ rgyud drang zhing gshis bzang ba/ mi chos la mkhas zhing*/ lha chos don du gnyer ba/ rigs can gyi bu mo/ gang la zab gnad kyi snyan rgyud sba bri med par cung zad 'bul ba'i rtsis su bya ba la/ spyir rang ro'i 'khor ba mya dam gyi 'brog dgon nyam nga ba 'di nas thar ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i grong khyer du 'gro bar 'dod pa la/ dad po rten pa bzang po dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la ma bsten par 'gro ba'i thabs med pas/ dang po dkon mchog gi yon tan rjes su dran dgos pas/ sangs rgyas la spongs rtogs kyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig mnga' na yag 'dir bsdus te bsam pa ni/ 7)spyir skyabs gnas kyi sangs rgyas de rang nyid la 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa med pa/ gzhan skyabs pa'i nus pa yod pa/ phan sems che ba/ rang 'dod med pa bzhi tshang dgos pa de sangs rgyas min pa su la'ang med/ sangs rgyas ni spang bya ma lus pa spang bas rang la 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad kyis 'jigs pa med pa/ rtogs bya mtha' dag rtogs pas ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes gnyis mnga' bas gzan skyob pa'i nus pa yod pa/ sems can thams cad la ma yi bu gcig po la brtse ba ltar dgongs pas phan sems che ba yin/ sangs rgyas rnams sgrub pas mnyes kyi mchod pas 8)de tsam mnyes pa ma yin pas rang 'dod med pa yin/ chos kyi yon tan ni/ de ltar sangs rgyas kyi yon tan de dag thams cad dam pa'i chos nyams su blang pas des ltar sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu'i yon tan rnams 'byung ba yin pas de chos kyi yon tan yin/

gzhan yang dam pa'i chos ni/ thog mar dge ba sogs dkon mchog rjes dran gyi mdo las gsung pa rnams shes dgos/ dge 'dun gyi yon tan ni/ chos nyams su len mkhan de dge 'dun yin pas/ sangs rgyas dang chos gnyis ka'i yon tan dge 'dun las mnga' ba/ chos rgyud ldan gyi gang zag de nyes pa'i dri ma zad pa'i phyir dang*/ lam gyi 9)mngon rtogs kyi yon tan dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa'i phyir/ des na/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ni/ thar pa 'dod pa rnams kyi skyabs/ zhes gsungs pas/ 'o skol thar pa'i lam tshol ba la/ ston pa sangs rgyas la brten dgos/ lam la dam pa'i cos la brten dgos/ de bsgrub pa'i grogs dge 'dun la bsten dgos pas/ nyams su len pa la/ ji skad du/ nyams len thun du bcad nas 'bad/ zhes gsungs pas/ las dang po pas/ tho rang dang po nas nam ma langs bar thor thun dang*/ de nas thun grol nas nyi ma dros chen bar tsam 10)chu gtor dang rgyun gyi dam chags med kyi thugs dam dang kha 'don la brtson/ nyi ma dros po che nas/ nyi gung bar snga thun/ 'di bar dpe ltas dang thod rgal la bltas la/ de nas nyi ma phyi dro tsam thun sdom nas nyi ma ma nub bar thun sdom/ de nas thun grol nas gtor ma dang tshogs mchod bsngo ba smon lam rnams 'don/ de nas mun rub pa dang mnyam du mi nyal phyi ba tsam bar thun sdom pas srod thun yin/ thun de re re bzhin du/ thun gyi sngon 'gro'i sngon 'gro/ phyir 'bud/ gshang lci 'dor/ snab 'bud/ gdong phyis/ sgo phyi nang gi bya ba byed dgos kyi rigs thams cad bsgrub nas thun 11)nang de nas rgyug mi dgos pa zhig byed nas/ thun gyi sngon 'gro dngos la ni/ mal na lus yod pa/ lus na sems yod pa/ sems nang lhod yod pa zhig byed nas/ sems 'das pa'i rjes mi bcad/ ma 'ongs pa'i mdun mi bsu/ da lta'i rnam rtog gi 'phro mi mthud par cung zad bzhag de'i rjes su sems ngan ma khyod nges de ring thun nang 'di nas nyon mongs 'khrul pa'i dbang du gtong re snyams pa'i dam bca' zhig byed nas/

lus gnad chos bdun nam/ skyil krung drang por bya/ lus drangs na rtsa drangs rtsa de drangs bas rlung drangs rlung drang na lalalasems las su rung ba'i dgos pa yod do/ de nas rlung 12)ro dgu phrug gam sum phrug re bya/ de dus dmigs pa rlung sna nas mnyam por ga lor drangs na lte 'og tu bcag la cu thad bzung nas/ rang gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las ngan sdig sgrib nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug dang khyad par du bsgom skyon bying rmug 'thib gsum thams cad rlung lalanag po zhig gis rnam pa phyir song bar bsam la rlung phyir 'bud/ 'di nas rlung ro dgu phrug gam sum phrug gsungs kyang*/ sems la nyon mongs dang rnam rtog ngan pa 'tshubs dus su thun dang thun mtshams gang la'ang ci mang 'bud pa gnad yin/ sems gnad kun slong bcos pa ni/ sems can 13)thams cad kyi don du bdag gis sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du thun 'di sdom/ nyams len 'di byed snyams lapas lus ngag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba che phra ci byed kyang bsam pa 'dis dus nam yang zin dgos/ de nas rang gi spyi bor me tog padma dkar po 'dab ma 'bum phrag gyes pa zi'u 'bru dmar ser brdal ba'i steng seng khri dar zab 'bol brtsegs kyi gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid sku ha cang yang mi bsgros pa dang mi gzhon pa dar la babs pa zhig thugs dgyes pa'i nyams dang bcas pas bzhugs pa mngon sum lta bur bsam nas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs so/ bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zab lam gyi rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la 14)skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ka dag gnas lugs kyi lta ba rtogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lhun grub snang bzhi'i ye shes mthar phyin par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes yid khyed kyi dad pas gsol ba dung dung ba btab nas bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med par 'dres par bsam la cung zad mnyam par bzhag

de rnams ni thun thams cad kyi sngon 'gro yin/ bla ma'i gsol 'debs 'di la 'phros don cung zad bshad na/ rang re dpon slob chos kyi 'brel zab che bas/ nge rang bsgom na spyir bla ma skyon kun zad dang yon tan kun rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi ngo bor blta dgos pa bzhir bzhag nas/ de'i steng du/ kho bo rdzogs chen gyi rig pa tshad phebs tsam du gsungs pa'i rtogs pa zhig sngar 'brug 15)gi lor bla ma'i gdan sa dkar lding ri khrod nas brnyes zin na'ang*/ mthong lam spang bya rnams/ da lo'i me stag gi lo de'i zla ba bcu pa'i nang tsam 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa mthong lam gi ngo skal du gyur pa thams cad sa bon tsam ma gtogs pa spangs zin pas/ mthong lam 'phags pa'i ye shes yin par khas blang kyang mi 'gal snyam pa zhig gi yon tan yod pa yin pas gsol ba btab na byin rlabs dang dngos grub 'byung nges par yin pa gsang rgyaḥ skabs su sems skye snang dang*/ lta sgom gyi zhen pas nga rgyal ba la sogs pa'i dus su/ bla ma'i gsol 'debs 'di rgyang glu la drangs te/ ༈ pha rje btsun bla ma rin po che/ khyod sangs rgyas kun dang dbyer med kyang*/ deng mos pa'i bu la thugs brtse bas/ 'phral 16)rgyal sras mchog gi tshul bzung nas/ lar bsam zhing skye ba bzhes mdzad pa'i/ rje rgyal ba'i dbang po klong chen pa/ pha khyod kyi byin rlabs mi dman yang*/ rgyud nyon mongs drag pos yongs bzungs nas/ las nag po'i spyod pa dar ba'i tshe/ dus snyigs ma lnga bde'i sems can rnams/ 'og ngan song g.yang sa kho nar ltung*/ pha thugs rjes gzigs shig klong chen pa/ las sngar byas rnams la don ma mchis/ chos sngar byas rnams la chos brgyad 'dres/ lam rnal ma bsgrub pa gcig ma dran/ da khyed rang min pa re sa med/ pha thugs rjes gzigs shig klong chen pa/ lar gshin rje'i skyes bu'i rgyab nas ded/ dus lo zla zhag gi mdun nas bsus/

'phral rnam g.yengs bya bas bar nas brid/ de ma tshog bslus shig byung nyan gda'/ pha 17)thugs rjes gzigs shig klong chen pa/ gzhon dbang po gsal tshe byis pa'i sems/ lus dar la bab tshe brel bas g.yengs/ da rgas shing 'khog par gyur pa'i tshe/ chos gsha' ma dran kyang phyi nas song*/ pha thugs rjes gzigs shig klong chen pa/ rang bsdad par 'dod kyang sdod dbang med/ nor khyer bar 'dod kyang khyer mi btub/ grogs 'grogs par 'dod kyang rang gcig pu/ sang 'jig rten pha rol 'gro bar nges/ pha thugs rjes gzigs shig klong chen pa/ tshe 'di yi bag chags 'pharan pa'i mthus/ lam bar do'i 'phrang la ci 'dra ang*/ dpe mdangs sum nyal ba'i rmi lam bzhin/ lar rang dbang thob pa shin tu dka'/ pha thugs rjes gzigs shig klong chen pa/ spyir 'khor ba'i chos la snying po med/ sgos mi 18)rtag lus la snying po med/ 'di nam mkha' shar ba'i 'ja' tshon 'dra/ de bden par bzung yang yal nas 'gro/ pha thung rjes gzigs shig klong chen pa/ yar sangs rgyas rnams la dad pa med/ mar sems can rnams la snying rje chung*/ gos ngur smrig gyon kyang gzugs brnyan tsam/ skra spu gris gzhar yang don sgo chung*/ pha thugs rjes gzigs shig klong chen pa/ chos thos pa mang yang gnad ma khrol/ kha bshad pa che yang rgyud ma dul gnas ri khrod 'grim kyang khyim la sred/ mig lta stangs byas kyang nyams myong med/ pha thugs rjes gzigs shig klong chen pa/ mi gzhan gyi skyon mtshangs chung ngu rig rang khong nas rul ba ye ma tshor/ mi gzhan gyi mgo bo bskor bskor nas/ sdug rang gi nyos pa ma lags sam/ pha thugs rjes 19)gzigs shig klong chen pa/ khong rgyal ba'i gsung rab ma lus kun/ sems rgyud la e phan mi sems par/ khe grags pa sgrub phyir thos bsam byas/ de thar pa'i lam du e 'gro aṃ/ pha thugs rjes gzigs shig klong chen pa/ nga chos pa'i tshul gyis 'jig rten sgrub/

lar skye bo kun gyi mchod pa len/ tshe yang yengs bya ba'i ngang du btang*/ dbugs khrog ger 'gro dus ci 'dra aṃ/ pha thugs rjes gzigs shig klong chen pa/ bdag de slad skyo ba gting nas skyes/ yar sangs rgyas rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ spyir snyigs ma'i dus kyi sems can dang*/ sgos chos gzugs tshul can bdag sogs la/ pha thugs rjes gzigs shig klong chen pa/ bu nga la re sa gzhan na med/ bya bral gyi skyid sdug khyed rang shes/ dbyings 20)zag med bde chen pho brang nas/ mgon khyed dang dbyer med ro gcig shog ces don la sems zhing glu dal mos len na bla ma'i byin rlabs btsan thabs su 'jug pa yin no/ 'di'i rjes su rang gi nyams la gang shar gyi glu ci dran re longs/ bla ma'i mos gus gnad du bsnun pa'i don brgyud kyi dgongs pa 'phos nas rig stong rjen pa'i ye shes 'bad med du rtogs/ kun rdzob 'khrul pa'i snang bden med rmi lam gyi rol par rtogs/ 'di dus lam rtags kyi yon tan dad pa nges 'byung snying rje dang*/ byang chub kyi sems sogs lhun grub tu 'byung*/ mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul thogs med du 'ong na lam rtags yang dag yin/ des 'phros don cung zad cig bshad zin/ ༈ da thun dngos gzhi la skyabs 'gro sogs gang nyams su len pa de gnad du 'gro nges pa re 21)ma byas par byis pa me tog gi tshal na rgyug pa bzhin du nyams len re la thug thug re byas nas sems la ma bskor na 'bras bu yid smon la re ba'i dus ngan gyi chos gzugs phal pa rnams dang 'dra ba las mi 'ong bas/ nyams len gang la'ang sems kyis dang po de'i tshig don la dpyad nas 'jogs/ yang de'i don la sems rtse gcig par 'jogs/ de 'dra bar re mos kyis ma bsam par/ nga ni gang zag che ge mo'i skye ba/ rig 'dzin ga ge mo'i lung byang na zin/ gter ston che ge mo'i mkha' 'gro yin bsam nas rang rgyud nga rgyal gyi sbos/

rang gi rgyud la brtags na gu ru yab yum gyi lung gis zin 'os kyis yon tan sna gcig rang rgyud la yod med la brtog dpyod zhib rgyas 'tshal/ de ltar brtags nas rang rgyud kyi ngan 22)mtshang gi skyon rnams rang la rang blo lkog du ma gyur pas/ skyon yod pa la de dang de'i gnyen por brten/ yon tan yod na gong nas gong 'phel du btang nas nyams len gnad du bsnun par byed na/ ji zhig na sems kyi ngo bo 'di da lta'i 'di dang mi 'dra ba zhig lhag gis mthong*/ de'i lag rjes la/ rjes thob suo sa thams cad bden med sgyu ma'i rol par rtogs/ nyon mongs pa gzhi med du sangs nas sems rtog phra mo yod byas na rags pa med/ med byas na 'phro rgyu zhig kyang yod dus/ khyed rang grol gyi rnal 'byor ma grub thob ḍa dril khrol lo ba/ rdo rje'i glu'i rgyang glu rtse ba zhig 'ong nyan mchis/ rgyun du skyabs 'gro'i tshogs zhing ma gsal na yang dkon mchog gi yon tan shes pa'i sgo nas/ bsam pa'i khyad par sems can thams 23)cad kyi don du bdag gis sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i ched du bsam/ yul gyi khyad par la/ sangs rgyas la thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam gyi ston pa bzung*/ chos la der 'gro ba'i lam du bzung*/ dge 'dun la lam sgrub pa'i grogs su 'jin pa'i sgo nas/ gsar rnying thun mong gi skyabs 'gro bzhi skor grags pa/ bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ dus kyi khyad par gnas skabs dang ji srid 'tsho'i bar dang mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi 'go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du mtho dman skyid sdug na tsha sdug bsngal ci byung yang khyed rang dkon mchog gi shes snyams pas blo gtad ling nge byas skyabs 'gro ci nus 24)byas/ ༈ blo sna mos gus kyis 'aprog pas lus sems tshugs mi nus pa'i gdung shugs snying gi dkyil/

rkang pa'i khong rus pa'i gting nas dung dung bskyed do/ ci mdzad khyed shes kyi blo gtad re ltos ling gis bskyur nas/ rang gis byad drangs te sems can thams cad kyis kyang gsol ba tshig dril du 'debs par mos la/ kye hoḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: spyi dpal bla ma rin po che: mthong bas ma rig mun pa sel: thos pas the tshom dra ba gcod/ dran pas dgongs brgyud rtogs pa 'pho/ reg pas byin rlabs dngos grub ster/ bka' drin bsam na brjod las 'das/ yon tan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ bzod med gdung shugs drag po yis/ gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes dgongs/ bdag lus 25)longs spyod dge rtsar bcas/ chags zhen med par khyod la 'bul/ 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ skyabs dang skyel ma mgon dang dpung*/ gtan gyi mgon po khyed las med/ blo snying brang gsum ling gis bkal: skyid sdug legs nyes thams cad dang*/ mtho dman gar gtong bla ma mkhyen/ bdag ni tshe rabs thog med nas/ ma rig 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur te/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i btson khang du/ bzod med sdug bsngal gsum gyis gdung*/ nyam thag zug rngu khur ma bzod/ snying nas rje btsun bla mar 'bod/ bde 'dod sdug bsngal las la brtson/ snang ba'i yul du bdud kyi bslus/ zhen pas gnyis 'dzin 'khrul par 'phyan/ bdag 'dra'i las ngan skal ngan la/ skyabs mgon 26)khyed las skyob pa su/ gsol ba 'debs so bla ma rje/ thugs rjes zung shig bka' drin can/ byin gyis rlobs shig nus mthu can/ rjes su zungs shig spyi dpal mchog blo sna chos la bsgyur du gsol/ dbang bzhi bskur bar mdzad du gsol/ sgrib bzhi dag par mdzad du gsol/ sku bzhi thob par mdzad du gsol/ dgongs brgyud byin rlabs bdag la 'phos/ ma rig mun pa drung 'byin nas/ gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i 'ching ba khrol/ mkhyen gzigs ye shes mngon gyur cing*/ chos zad blo 'das chen por skyol/

lhun grub gzhon nu bum pa'i sku/ 'ja' lus chen por dbugs 'byin mdzod/ ces ji tsam nus par gsol ba phur tshugs su gdab/ ༈ de nas/ rgyun du dkon mchog gi skyabs 'og na blo bde 27)'bol le dge sbyor la brtson na/ nyi ma'i snying po'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas skyabs su sems can su 'gro ba/ bdud rnams bye bas bsad par mi nus te/ tshul khrims nyams shing blo ni zhig gyur kyang*/ nges par skye bo 'khor ba'i pha rol 'gro/ zhes dang*/ gang zhig sangs rgyas skyabs 'gro ba/ de ni yang dag dge bsnyen te/ de ni bskal pa stong du ni/ ngan song 'gro bar mi 'gyur ro/ zhes/ gsungs pa'i phan yon dran nas/ phyi pa dang nang pa'i khyad skyabs 'gro yin pas gal po che yin la/ de nas/ dge bshes spyan snga ba chen poso sa kyi mgo 'chi ba mi rtag pas bzung dgos gsungs pas de ltar na/ chos bsgrub pa la ge le gu le'i sos dal gyi long khong med pas mi rtag cing 'chi ba rjes su dran 28)dgos/ 'o skol yang tshe pha rol du 'gro bas mi dga' zhing*/ tshe 'dir gtan du sdod par 'dod kyang 'dug pa'i dbang med par nyi ma nub ri la chas pa bzhin du myur du 'gro dgos pas/ sngar gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ mi skya/ btsan btsun sogs thams cad sdod dbang med par 'chi ba'i chos nyid yin par bsam nas mi rtag par dran dgos/ 'di la rtsa ba gsum dang*/ rgyu mtshan dgu bshad na yang*/ 'dir rtsa ba gsum pa bsam bya yin/ nges par ni 'chi/ nam 'chi nges pa ni med/ 'chi ba'i tshe gang gis kyang mi phan pa gsum bsam bya yin/ dang po ni/ rang re skye ba'i nub mo nas bzung*/ ma shi'i bar du mi tshe los 'dzad/ lo zla bas 'dzad/ 29)zla ba zhag gis 'dzad/ nyin zhag yud tsam dang*/ zhag skad cig ma'i rgyun phri li li 'dzad pa dper na ri gzar gyi ngos nas 'bab chu'am nam mkha'i glog bzhin bas myur zhing mgyogs par 'gro bas tshe 'dzad tshul rnams bsam dgos/

gnyis pa nam 'chi nges par med pa ni/ rang gi tshe 'dir ji tsam gnas pa'i yun de sngon gyi dge ba'i las kyi 'phan pa yin pas de de ring ngam sang nyin nam/ lo zla phyi ma gang la zad ma nges pas/ dper na mar me snum zad pa lta bu'am/ mda' 'phen pa'i skyes bu'i mtheb mo'i shugs rdzogs pa lta bur/ mar me shi ba'am/ mda' sdod pa bzhin du bsam nas skyo ba bskyed dgos/ gsum pa/ 'chi ba'i dus la bab pas na gang gis yang mi phan pa ni/ 'chi 30)ba'i tshe na phan byed dge ba dang gnod byed sdig pa gnyis las med pas/ tshe 'di'i pha dang*/ khu bo dang*/ ma dang*/ bu mo dang grogs dang*/ dga' mdza' dang*/ nor dang*/ longs spyod gang gis kyang mi phan par/ rang nyid mal gyi nang du gces par bskyangs pa'i lus 'di yang bzhag nas gcer bu lag stong mchan du bcug nas/ 'gro dus phan gnod dge sdig gnyis las med tshul la/ da lta bsam gzhig legs par btang nas/ dge ba med na sgrub tsheyod pa'i ring la ci 'grub gang bsgrub bya/ sdig pa yod na bshags pa ci nus re byed na dag 'gro bar sdig pa'i mtshan nyid yin pas dran pa dang mi dran pa'i sdig pa la snying nas bshags cing*/ da phyin chad mi byed pa'i dam bca' brten par bzung*/ spyan snga bas/ 'chi 'chi zhes rgyun du bsam na/ 31)ma shi'i bar dge sbyor 'phel po 'ong gsungs pa bzhin/ lus ngag gi dge ba phra mo nas khyad du mi gsod par ci 'grub gang bsgrub byed dgos/ ༈ de nas dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba bsam pa ni/ chu bo chen po rgal ba la gru dgos pa de bzhin du/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las brgal ba la/ dal 'byor gyi gru yod pa dgos te/ zhi ba lhas/ dal 'byor mi yi gru la brtan nas ni/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal chu bo che las sgrol/ zhes gsungs pa de bzhin du/ 'khor ba ni rgya mcho dang 'dra/ mi lus ni gru dang 'dra/ sems ni mgron po dang 'dra/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni gru pa dang 'dra ba las/

rten 'brel 'dzom pa'i dus tshod 'di la 'khor ba las ci sgrol byed dgos pas so/ gu 32)ru rin po ches/ rnyed par dka' ba u dum wa ra dang*/ rnyed par don chen yid bzhin nor bu 'dra/ zhes gsungs pas/ rgyu sā ma'i tshul khrims rnam par dag pas rgyu byas/ dge ba'i bsags rgyab mang pos grogs byas/ rkyen smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyar bas/ dal 'byor bco brgyad dang ldan pa'i mi lus rin po che thob pa'i dus tshod 'dir/ dge ba sgrub na yar 'gro ba'i sa mtshams/ mi dge ba zhig sgrub na mar 'gro ba'i sa mtshams/ rta kha srab kyis bsgyur ba'i dus tshod/ tshe gang dus brgya'i za ma lan gcig thob pa bzhin yin par bsam nas/ dal 'byor gyi lus rten 'di la rnyed par dka' bar shes nas/ lus kyi snying po phyag re re'am/ ngag gi bzlas brjod tshig 'bru re re'am/ sems kyi dge ba'i 33)bsam pa skad cig ma re re bsam nas snying po ci lon byed dgos/ spyan snga bas/ dal 'byor rnyed pa dka' ba gcig pu 'di bsgoms nas mi g.yo ba'i bsnyen pa dung phyur dgu gsungs nas grol ba thob pa lags/ ༈ de nas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa ni/ da res re zhig ngan song gsum las thar nas/ mi lus lan gcig thob pa 'di/ gtan gyi btsan sa zin pa'i nges pa med pas/ lha'i nang nas tshangs pa dang brgya byin lta bu'i lus thob kyang*/ las kyi dbang gis slar yang dmyal ba'i bud shing byed dgos te/ klu sgrub kyis/ tshangs gnas bde 'byung bde ba thob nas slar mnar med me yi bu shing brten 'tshal lo/ zhes gsung ba bsam mo/ mi'i gnas 'dir 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal 34)po lta bur skyes kyang 'khor ba'i yang bran nyid du 'gyur ba la yang tshegs med la/ mtho ris kyi bde ba'i longs spyod la spyad spyad nas/ slar yang ngan song gi sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa la spyod dgos pas/ rgya cher rol pa las/ 'dod pa thams cad mi rtag brtan pa med/

ther zug ma yin rmi lam 'dra ba ste/ smig rgyu dang 'dra sgyu ma rmi lam 'dra/ glog dang sbu ba 'dra zhing 'gyur ba yin/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin du/ 'khor ba'i sems can rnams ni dmus long 'brog dgon du rkang 'khyams pa dag stag dang*/ seng ge la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa dang bcas/ der za rgyu ni med/ lam mkhan dang ni ya bral/ gang du phyin kyang thar pa'i phyogs ni mi shes pa bzhin du/ 'khor ba'i sems can rnams ni/ thabs dang shes rab kyi mig gnyis 35)ni long*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi long khrid dang ni bral/ sbyin pa'i rgyags phye ni med/ ngan song gi 'jigs pa dang bcas te/ dmyal ba tsha grang gis sdug bsngal/ yi dwags bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal/ dud 'gro na blun cing gti mug pa'i sdug bsngal/ mtho ris na sdug bsngal snga ma ma sangs bar phyi mas non pa'i sdug bsngal bde ba sgrub pas sdug bsngal gyi rgyur 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/ de dag thams cad mi rtag cing 'pho bas khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal las ma 'das pa/ srin mo'i gling dang*/ me yi 'bos dang*/ mi gtsang ba'i 'dam rdzab lta bu'i 'du shes bzhag nas bsam zhing*/ da ni 'khor ba'i rgyu/ 'dod pa'i yon tan skyon dang nyes dmigs du shes nas/ bslab 36)pa gsum gyi rta la zhon nas/ 'khor ba'i bde ba la phyi mig mi lta bar 'gro dgos pas/ 'di nas rgyas bar ni sngon 'gro'i nang la ltos/ rgyun gyi nyams len 'dis ma chog pa med/ ༈ da ni 'di nas mar las rgyu 'bras kyi rnam bzhag rgyas pa zhig ma bshad na/ deng sang gi sgoms chen chos pa rlobs pa phal mo che/ las rgyu 'bras 'di mi shes bzhin du/ dge bas phan mi btags/ sdig pas gnod mi skyel zer nas/ mi dge ba bcu spang gi tshul khrims tsam yang med par rtogs ldan dang grub thob tu rloms pa mang zhig mthong nas/ khyed la de'i gnad cung zad tsam zhig zhu na/ jo bo rin po ches/

snying rje chen po nga la gson/ lus kyi mi dge rnam gsum 37)dang*/ ngag gi mi dge rnam pa bzhi/ yid kyi mi dge rnam gsum gang yin pa/ mi dge bcu zhes zer bar 'dug srog gcod gzhan nor rku 'phrog dang*/ 'dod log mi tshangs spyod pa dang*/ gang zhig bslu ba'i rdzun tshig smra/ ku re'i ched du rdzun zer dang*/ phra ma dag 'khyal nyon mongs tshig tshig rtsub brlangs por brjod pa dang*/ brnab sems gnod sems log lta te/ gzhan nor rang la sems pa dang*/ gnod pa gzhan la skyel sems dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la bskur 'debs gang*/ de ni mi dge bcu po yin/ de spang bzlog gyur dge ba bcu/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis pha dang*/ ma dang*/ mkhan po dang*/ slob dpon dang*/ de bzhin 38)gshegs pa dang*/ chos kyi mig can rnams ni/ yul khyad par can yin pas bsad na bar do med par/ sngags pa kun na re/ rdo rje'i dmyal ba zer/ spyi'i skad la mnar med pa'i dmyal ba zer/ mngon pa kun btus nas bshad na yar la thob pa'i skabs med pa tsam du gda'/ 'dir mtshams med der ma ltung ba cig gal che/ dug dang mtshon dang ngan sngags kyi sbyor bas/ srog chags kyi rigs su gyur pa bsad kyang las kyi rnam par smin pas ngan song gsum du skye ste/ 'di ni the mi tshom pa'i las yin no/ srog chags kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad rang gis bsad pa dang*/ gzhan la gsod du bcug gam/ gsod pa la rjes su yi rang nas byed pa'am gang byas kyang ngan song gsum du skye ba'i las yin no/ dper 39)na 'jag mig gi srin bu yan chod nas mi man chod bsad par mi bya'o/ yul khyad par can de dag ni smos ci 'tshal/ 'brom ston pa khyed kyi lus la/ nyi ma nyin gcig la mdung thung sum brgya tsam gcig gis rgyun chad med par bsnun la/ de la'ang shir mi nyan pa'i dus su na tsha dang sdug bsngal ci tsam cig 'ong*/ jo bo de 'dra ni bzod brlag mi gda'/

'brom ston pa de nas na sems can sdug bsngal chung ngu'i nang gi'ang chung ngu brgya stong gi char yang mi nye bar bshad do/ 'brom ston de lta bas na srog gcod par mi bya'o/ gdod du gzhugs pa mi bya'o/ gsod pa la rjes su yi rang bar mi bya'o/ gal te mir skyes na yang nad mang zhing tshe thung ngo*/ gzhan yag bdag pos yongs su bzung ba'i 40)nor/ mthu dang*/ sngags dang*/ 'jab bu la sogs pas ma byin par blang bar mi bya'o/ 'di lta ste/ mi rku mi 'phrog tha na kha gsags dang gzhog slong yan chad mi bya'o/ gal te byas par gyur na gong bzhin du ngan song gsum las lam med do/ phal cher yi dwags su skye bar bshad/ 'brom gal te mir skyes na yang longs spyod kyi dbul zhing 'phongs la/ bzar med btsul du'ang med/ gyon du'ang med pa'i mi lus tsam mo/ 'brom ston pa mi tshangs pa spyad pa rnam pa nas rnam pa thams cad du mi spyad/ ma dang sring mo la sogs pa nye 'brel rnams sun mi dbyung*/ dge slong ma sogs sdom bsrungs rnams sun mi dbyung*/ gzhan yang dus ma yin par gzhan na ba'am/ nyin mo'am rma sgo gzhan du spyod pa la sogs pa 'dod pa'i 41)log par g.yem pa zhes bya ste/ ngan song gsum du mu mtha' med par 'gro ba'i rgyu yin pas mi tshangs lalapa spyod dang bcas te rnam pa nas rnam pa thams cad du mi bya'o/ gal te mir skyes kyang khyim gyi sdug bsngal chen pos mnar te/ sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po myong bar 'gyur ro/ de dag kyang gzhan spyod du 'jug pa dang*/ rjes su yi rang byed pa la sogs pa gong dang mthun/ gzhan yang rdzun du smra ba dang*/ phra ma dang*/ ngag 'khyal pa dang*/ tshig rtsub mo 'di dag gis kyang ngan song mu mtha' med par skye ba'i rgyur che bas rnam pa nas rnam pa thams cad du spang bar bya'o/ gal te mir skyes kyang gzhan gyi tshad mar mi 'dzin cing mi bskur ba mang ba dang*/ ngag mi btsun zhing gzhan gyi co 'dri ba'i gnas su byed pa

42)dang*/ mi dang mi mdza' zhing gzhan gyi rang nyid la mthun pa'i grogs dang 'byed pa dang*/ mi kha sdang zhing don med pa thams cad kyis kyang brlangs tshig du brjod du 'ong ba la sogs pas mi'i bde ba dang bral/ dpe na mi dge ba bdun po spongs ba dang dge ba bdun du bsten par byed shes par bya ste/ dge ba bdun po la gzhan yang bkod/ sgrub pa po rnams la'ang mthun 'gyur brjod 'brom ston pa khyod rang dang 'dra ba'i btsan sa zin pa 'khor bar skyes kyang sla ba/ gzhan don 'ba' zhig la dmigs pa la ni mi dge ba bdun thabs dang sbyar te spyad/ de ni mi dge ba ltar snang ba'o/ 'brom ston pa bla ma dang dkon mchog gi nor dang*/ nad pa dang*/ ma nus pa'i nor la sogs pa/ gzhan gyi rdzas rang la yod na ci dga'i brnab sems mi bya/ yin na ci ma 43)rung*/ ci thob bya'o/ snyam pa'i brnab sems mi bya'o/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' la'ang bkag gzhan yang*/ gzhan nyes na dga' ba dang*/ brlag na dga' ba dang*/ med na dga'/ sdug bsngal na dga' ba dang*/ gsod sems la sogs pa gnod pa'i sems thams cad rnam pa nas rnam pa thams cad du mi bya'o/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas mi bden chos mi bden/ dge 'dun mi bden/ 'jig rten la snga phyi med/ las rgyu 'bras med zer nas chos byas pas sdug bsngal byung ba rtags su 'god na/ de dag ni log par lta ba bya ba de yin pas/ de 'dra ba'i las kyi 'khor ba dang ngan song las thar ba mi srid de/ de ni rnam pa thams cad du mi bya'o/ 'brom mi dge ba bcu nyes dmigs dang bcas pa mdor mtshon 44)tsam bshad/ gzhan khyod rang mdo sde la ltos zhes gsungs pas/ mi dge ba bcu spong gi tshul khrims 'di'i steng du 'chad 'gyur gyi rtsa ba'i dam tshig lnga pa bsrung na/ ma hā/ a nu/ a ti/ yo ga'i dam tshig ji snyed pa ming gi btags lugs kyi khyad par ma gtogs dam tshig thams cad 'dus pa phur pa zhe sdang khros pa'i rgyud dang rdzogs chen man ngag rnams las gsungs pa yin pas gnad 'dus par shes nas bsrung 'tshal/

༈ da ni sngags kyi tshul khrims sam sdom pa'i dam tshig tsam ma bshad na/ ming sngags pa khas blangs don dam tshig bsrung ba lta cing*/ dam tshig gi rkang grangs tsam yang mi shes pa'i skyon du 'gyur gyi dgos nas de bshad pa na/ rtsa rgyud gsang ba snying po las/ bla med mi spang bla ma bskur/ yang dag lam du 45)zhugs la byams/ sngags dang phyag rgya rgyun mi bcad/ gsang ba'i don bcu smra mi bya/ zhes/ rtsa ba lnga dang yan lag nyer lngar gsung na/ yan lag nyer lnga rnams/ rtsa ba bsrung ba'i thams kyi yan lag dang sman shing ra ba lta bu dang nyams na nyes pa chung bas/ rtsa ba lngar dam tshig thams cad rdzogs par gsungs pas/ de ni sgegs pa'i rdo rje'i dam tshig gsal bkra las/ bzhir bslus te/ ngo bo rtsa ba bzhi dang ni/ thun mong thun min yan lag gnyis/ zhes pas/ bla med mi spang ba byang chub sems kyi dam tshig dang gcig slob dpon bskur ba dang mched la byams pa ni sku'i dam tshig dang gnyis/ sngags dang phyag rgya rgyun mi bcad pa gsung gi dam tshig dang gsum/ gsang bcu 46)gzhan la mi bsgrags pa thugs kyi dam tshig dang bzhir gsung yang bzhi dang lnga dbye bsdus khyad par tsam du shes nas/ dang po bla med mi spang ba la kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dang*/ don dam byang chub kyi sems mi spang ba gnyis kyi/ dang po/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems mi spang ba ni/ sngags rang gi thun min ni/ rang gi bsgoms rgyu'i lha sgrub zhi ba bzhi bcu zhe gnyis dang*/ sems can thams cad mtshungs par lha rtog dbyer med du shes nas/ de la 'god 'dod kyi bsam pa mi spang ba yin/ mdo sngags thun mong du/ rgyal po gsal rgyal la gdams pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa'i khyim pas smon pa byang chub kyi sems gcig po de ma spang na/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa thams cad 'du zhing sangs rgyas thob par 47)gsung la byang chub sems dpa'i rtsa ltung la sogs su bsrung mi dgos par sngags kyi kun rdzob byang chab kyi sems la 'dus par shes dgos pas/

rgyal po la gdams pa'i mdo las/ rgyal po chen po/ khyod ni 'di ltar bya ba mang ba/ byed pa mang ba ste/ thams cad kyi rnam pa thams cad du sbyin pa la bslab pa nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i bar la bslab mi nus kyi/ de nas na/ rgyal po chen po/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la 'dun pa dang dad pa dang don du gnyer ba dang*/ smon pa'i 'gro yang rung*/ 'grong yang rung*/ 'dug kyang rung*/ nyal kyang rung*/ sad kyang rung*/ za yang rung*/ 'thung kyang rung*/ rtag par rgyun du dran par gyis la yid la bzungs te bsgom shig sangs rgyas dang so 48)so'i skye bo thams cad dang*/ bdag gi dus gsum gyi dge ba thams cad bsdus shing gzhol te rjes su yi rang bar gyis shig rjes su yi rang ba mchog gi rjes su yi rang ba/ nam mkha' dang 'dra ba dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa dang mtshungs pas rjes su yi rang lalalab gyis shig rjes su yi rang nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas thams cad la rjes su yi rang ba'i dge ba de mchod pa phul cig phul nas sems can thams cad dang thun mong sar gyis shig de nas sems can thams cad rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar du thob par 'gyur ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur bar nyin gcig bzhin du dus gsum du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang 49)chub tu yongs su bsngos shig rgyal po chen po/ de ltar zhugs na rgyal po'i bya ba yang nyams par mi 'gyur zhing*/ byang chub kyi tshogs kyang yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ zhes byang chub la 'dun pas dad pa don gnyer smon pa zhes pas rnam mkhyen blos btang nas/ nyan rang du sems bskyed pa'i rnam mkhyen blos btang spang dgos par gsung*/ thun mong du gyis shig nas/ de nas sems can thams cad rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar du thob par 'gyur ba dang*/ zhes pa'i bar gyi sems can blos btang*/

rang la gnod pa'i dgra lta bu gcig la phan 'dogs kyi bsam pa med par spang na/ sems can gzhan rnams ma spang ba yang go mi chod par rtsa ltung 'byung bas/ sems can 50)thams cad rnam mkhyen ma thob bar gyi bde ba mtho ris nas sa bcu'i bar dang*/ mthar rnam mkhyen la 'god 'dod ma spang ba 'di la byang chub sems dpa'i rtsa ltung thams cad 'dus par ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal bzhes gnang ba lags pas/ rnam mkhyen dang*/ sems can blos mi btang ba gnyis po 'di bsrung na byang chub sems dpa'i rtsa ltung mi shes snyams pa'i yi mug de mi dgos lags/ ༈ gnyis pa don dam byang chub kyi sems ni/ rang rig dag mnyam chen po rig stong ljon pa'i ye shes de rtog ge tshig la zhen pas blor mi shong nas spang ba'am/ min kyang lta sgom spyod pas rab rgyun du dam/ tha na dus gsum du dran par byas te/ nyams su ma blang na/ dam tshig gsal bkra las/ dran dang shes bzhin sngon btang 51)nas/ dus gsum rgyun du ma dran na/ theg chen sngags par ci zhig tshud/ zhes gsungs pas/ sngags kyi ngo bo dag mnyam chen po'i lta ba 'di nyin bzhin ma dran na/ sngags pa'i gral du ci zhig gi tshud de mi tshud zhes brnyes tshig gis bstan pa yin no/ rtsa ba'i gnyis pa bla ma bskur ba ni/ bskur yul ni/ slob dpon drug ste spyi'i slob dpon ni/ rang gi thun mong ba skyabs sems nas/ rgyud sde snod gsum gyi chos kyi zhu ba'i bla ma yin/ dper na 'jig rten pa'i lugs kyi rgyal po tsam du bskur dgos/ dbang zhu dus kyi rgyal tshab kyi slob ma de dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du 'dren pas na 'dren pa'i bla ma zhes bya ba yin/ de rang gi khu bo tsam du bskur dgos/ zab mo nang rgyud sde gsum gyi gzhi dbang 52)rang la rab dbang don gyi lta ba rtogs pa'am/ 'brig bde gsal mi rtog gsum gyi nyams skyes/ tha na yang sgo rdo rje gsum gyi nges shes 'grogs pa'i dbang zhu ba de dam tshig dbang gi slob dpon yin/

de 'dra ma yin pas dbang pa zhus rdo zhus kyi dbang thob kyi go mi chod pas zhu sa de bla mar khur mi dgos/ gzhi dbang khyad par can de thob yul gyi bla ma de rang gi pha bzhin du bskur dgos/ bla ma dang mched la nyams chags song na de bshags pa'i yul gyi bla ma de nyams chag bskang ba'i slob dpon yin pas/ rang gi ma bzhin du bskur dgos/ rgyud gzhung thams cad zhus nas chos dang chos min gyi shan 'byod mdzad pa'i bla ma de shes rgyud grol ba'i slob dpon yin pas/ de rang gi mig gi 'bras bu bzhin du bskur dgos/ rang gi 53)da lta'i nyams su blang bya'i chos bskyed rdzogs kyi man ngag zhu ba'i yul de ni/ man ngag lung gi slob dpon bya ba de yin pas/ de rang gi snying las lhag par bskur dgos/ bskur tshul gyi dpe rim pa bzhin slob dpon drug po snga ma bas phyi ma gnyan/ bka' drin drug po bla ma gcig las thon na shin tu gnyan/ sngags kyi slob dpon dang 'gal ba'i rtsa ltung 'byung nges la/ dbang dang rgyad bshad man ngag ston pa'i slob dpon phyi ma gsum po de yin/ bla ma sgo gsum gyi ji ltar bskur dgos na/ lus kyi sgo nas zas nor la sogs pas mnyes par bya ba dang*/ gdan bting ba dang*/ khur ba dang*/ zhabs 'bring dgos pas/ bya ba thams cad la bran bzhin du rang che dang nga rgyal med par bya ba dang*/ ma gnang bar nor rdzas la ma 54)byin par ma blang*/ bag med du mi spyod/ ngag gi sgo nas bla ma'i mdzad spyod 'gal ba ltar snang yang gzhan la gsang*/ yon tan gyi bye brag thams cad gzhan la sgrogs/ rtse mo tsam yang skyon med pa la yod par sgros mi 'dogs/ yon tan yod pa la med par bskur ba mi gdab/ yid kyi sgo nas bla ma la/ shes bzhin du g.yo sgyu dang*/ phrag dogs dang*/ ngan sems dang*/ gnod sems dang*/ 'phya sems dang*/ mnar sems skad cig tsam du'ang mi bya ba rnams so/ rtsa ba'i gsum pa yang dag lam du zhugs pa la byams pa ni/

yul la nang gses mched bzhi ste/ spyi'i mche sems can thams da bde gshegs snyig po rigs gcig gis bsdus pa'i mched yin pas byams pa dang*/ snying rje bsgom zhing pha tsho bzang po bzhin 55)bskur/ ring ba'i mched sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs so cog dkon mchog gsum la re ba 'cha' ba rnams yin/ de tsha zhang tshan bzhin du blta/ nye ba'i mched sngags la zhugs so cog rnams yin/ de pha spun gyi nye ba bzhin du blta/ nang 'dres pa'i mched/ bla ma gcig dang dkyil 'khor gcig gis bsdus pa'i mched grogs rnams yin pas/ de pha ma gcig pa'i spun bzhin du bskur dgos/ rdo rje'i mched dang 'gal ba'i rtsa ltung rtsings nges pa can bla ma gcig pa dang dkyil 'khor gcig pa'i mched de yin no/ snga ma gsum po de tsam mi gnyan/ rtsa ba'i bzhi pa sngags dang phyag rgya rgyun mi bcad pa ni/ sngags ni gsum/ rgyu ma nor ba rtsa ba'i sngags ni/ lha'i sa bon hūṃ hrīḥl 56)sogs pa lta bu/ bskyed pa rkyen gyi sngags ni lha bskyed pa'i sngags/ des na hūṃ badzra dhṛka lta bu bzlas pa las kyi sngags ni sa bon dag bskyed sngags gnyis ka bsgrel ba rgyun du bzla/ rgyu'i sngags de yin/ phyag rgya bzhi ni/ bca' ba dam tshig gi phyag rgya ni/ lha rang rang gi mchod pa gar mchod rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na/ khrag 'thung rgyal po'i gar rgya/ thod khrag gi rgya'am/ sgron ma'i utpala'i rgya'am/ 'jam dpal gyi ral gri'i rgya'am/ rdo rje dag rin po che la sogs pa'i rgya'am/ gnas gsum byin rlabs kyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i rgya lta bu dang*/ rigs lnga spyi'i phyag rnams yin/ dkrol ba las rgya/ yab kyi phyag rgya g.yas nas g.yon du pad skor gyi bsgyur nas thabs la shes rab stong pa yum gyis rgyas 57)'debs/ yum gyi phyag rgya g.yon nas g.yas su pad skor gyi bsgyur nas shes rab la thabs yab snang ba'i rgyas 'debs pa yin/

bsam pa chos kyi rgya ni/ phyag rgya de dag lha de dag gi phyag mtshan yab kyi rdo rje dang*/ yum gyi dril bu la sogs par rang rang gi sa bon gyi mtshan pa 'od 'bar bsam pa yin/ sku nyid phyag rgya chen po ni/ lha de bsgom pa ni/ mdor na lha bsgom mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa'i phyag rgya bcas/ sngags bzla ba rnams tsam la 'dus par gsungs/ sngags dang phyag rgya 'di rnams/ rab rgyun du'am/ 'bring nyin mtshan gyi dus gsum mam/ tha ma zla ba byung ngo cog gi dus nyams su blangs dgos par gsungs so/ rtsa ba'i lnga pa/ gsang ba bcu mi sgrags pa la/ nang 58)gses bcu yod pa las/ spyir gsang bzhi/ bar gsang bzhi/ gsang 'os gnyer gtad gnyis dang bcu'o/ dang po bzhi ni/ dam tshig gsal bkra las/ lta zab spyod pa rlangs po dang*/ lha mir gzugs dang grub rtag rnams/ spyir gsang dang ni rnam bzhir bshad/ ces gsungs pas/ mngon sum ye shes kyi lta ba zab mo dang*/ rang gi rgyun du bsgom rgyu'i yi dam gyi lha dang*/ rang gi dbang bskur zhu dus kyis bla mas gnang ba'i gsang mtshan ming dang*/ grogs gzung ma mtshan ldan dang*/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las bzhi'i grub rtags dngos nyams rmi lam gang du byung ba dang bzhi po/ spyir gsang dgos/ bar gsang bzhi ni/ gsal bkra las/ bsgrub pa'i gnas dus grogs dang rdzas/ rab tu 59)gsag la bsgrub par bya/ zhes pas/ gang du bsgrub pa'i gnas/ lo zla zhag dus kyi bsgrub pa'i dus tshod/ bsgrub po'i grogs rnams rnal 'byor pho mo/ sgrub rdzas la nye bar mkho ba'i sku gsung thugs dang dkyil 'khor gyi yo byad rnams gsang*/ gsang ba 'os pa ni/ dam tshig gsal bkra las/ gsang ba 'os pa mdor bsdus na/ phud dang gtor ma tshogs dag dang*/ bhan dha phur pa mar med snod/ rdzas dang lag cha dkyil 'khor rnams/ skye bos mthong bar yongs mi bya/ dril bu rnga chung la sogs sgra/ skye bos thos pa yongs mi brdungs/ grogs po'i spyod dang mtshangs rnams dang*/

sems can kun gyi ngan spyod dang*/ kun la gnod pa'i spyod pa rnams/ shin tu gsang ba byang 60)chub tu/ zhes ma bkrol kyang lung gis go bas/ kun la gnod pa'i spyod pa ni dug sbyor dang*/ ngan sngags dang*/ mthu gtad rnams lags/ de rnams gsang ba 'os pa yin/ gsang ba gnyer gtad ni/ de nyid las/ gnyer gtad pa yi dam pa ste/ sngar bshad slob dpon mched kyis dngos/ zhes dang*/ gong du bshad pa de rnam shes dang*/ gzhan yang slob dpon dang*/ mched lcam gyi chos dang 'brel ba'i bya ba 'di gyis 'di ma byed ces gsang ba gnyer gtad pa rnams so/ gong gi gsang ba bcu po gsang yul ni/ gsal bkra las/ dam nyams dam las log pa dang*/ dam med dkyil 'khor ma mthong zhing*/ 'dres dang ma 'dres thams cad la/ zhes/ phyi rnal 'byor pa'i cha lugs tsam 'dzin kyang*/ 61)nang sems la dam tshig nyams pa dang*/ chags lugs dang dam tshig gnyis ka nyams pa'i skye bo phal pa'i spyod pa can dam las log pa dang*/ dam tshig med pa'am/ ma thob pa dbang gi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba dang*/ nang 'dres pa'i mched dang*/ ma 'dres pa'i mched lcam thams cad la gsang dgos/ gsang tshul ni/ de nyid las/ sems kyis bstan par mi bsam zhing*/ lus kyi sgo nas gsang yod kyang*/ lus kyi thams cad sbas la spyad/ ngag gi rdo rje'i lce yod kyang*/ brjod pa ngag tu bya ba min/ zhes dang*/ sems kyi sgo nas gsang yul la gang yang bstan par mi bsam/ lus kyi sgo nas gsang bya de thams cad thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas sbas par bya/ ngag gi sgo nas gsang bya de 62)rnams brjod par mi bya'o/ de ltar rtsa ba'i dam tshig lnga po 'di thugs la bzung nas nyin mtshan gyi drug cha'i thun re re bzhin du rtsis bgrangs mdzad nas/ rtsa ltung byung na thun gyi drug cha re 'das ma shor na/ bshags pa byed na sngags sdom mi gtong drug cha 'das shor na/ sngags sdom yang gtong*/ ma bshags na las kyi rnam par smin pas rdo rje'i dmyal ba las 'gro sa med par shes nas/

blang dor gyi gnas mi brjed pa'i dran pa sgo ba lta bu dang*/ sgo gsum la btags par byed pa shes bzhin bya ra ba lta bu dang*/ 'jug ldog gi gnas la gzob pa bag yod bag ma gsar ba lta bu gsum gyi bsrungs nas rang rgyud la nyes pa'i dri mas ma gos pa zhig dgos/ rtsa ba lnga po 'di bsrung nus na dam ldan yin/ ma srung na dam nyams yin no/ 63)yan lag nyer lnga la phan yon dang nyes pa gnyis ka cung zad tsam chung na yang*/ khyod kyi thugs la spro ba yod na ngo bo tsam bshad na/ nang gses nyer lnga yod pa'i dang po shes bya lta ba'i dam tshig lnga ni/ phung po lnga 'byung ba lnga dbang yul dang bcas pa/ rgyal ba yab lnga yum lnga sems dpa' sems ma ste/ gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor du blta ba yin/ bsgrub bya bsgom pa'i lnga ni/ rang gi me tog phog pa'i lha gtso bor bzung nas rigs lnga'i sgrub par bya ba yin/ spyod pa'i dam tshig la bco lnga las/ sbyor ba'i dam tshig sgrol ba'i dam tshig ma byin len pa'i dam tshig rdzun du smra ba'i dam tshig ngag rlangs po'i dam tshig rnams kyi don/ sbyor sgrol gnyis stabs gcig tu bshad 64)pa ni/ sgyu 'phrul brgyad cu las/ sbyor ba nyid na sgrol ba ste/ sgrol ba nyid la sbyor ba rdzogs/ zhes dang*/ blo gros mchog gi rnal 'byor pas/ rang byung gi ye shes rtogs pas yul/ stong pa nyid la sbyor tsa na/ gzung 'dzin gyi mtshan ma sgrol ba'o/ yang*/ dbang po'i yul gyi rtogs tshogs thams cad rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs sbyor tsa na/ rtog pa rang kha ma las sgrol ba ste/ rang bzhin dbang po'i yul gyi sbyor sgrol 'di gsang sngags nang pa'i 'jug sgo yin pas/ de lta bu'i rtogs goms kyi gdengs dang ldan pa'i rnam 'byor pas/ bsgral ba'i zhing bcu tshangs ba bsgral dgos pas/ dam tshig gsal bkra las/ dkon mchog slob dpon sku dgra dang*/ dam nyams log dang 'khu ba dang*/ 'du ba 'ong dang yongs

65)la gnod/ dam dgra ngan pa'i ngang tshul can/ ngan song gsum dang bcu po ni/ rnal 'byor kun gyi dang du blangs/ zhes pas/ ngan song gi rgyu la spyod pa bdun dang*/ 'bras bu la spyod pa gsum po mtshings pa gsum ldan gyi sgo nas ma bsgral na dam tshig nyams/ bde stong gnyis med la goms pas chags pa rang kha log pa'i rnal 'byor pas don gnyis sgrub pa'i phyir/ gzungs ma mtshan ldan la ma sbyor bar spang na yang dam tshig nyams par bshad/ 'di gnyis la phan yon dpag tu med par bshad kyang dgos pa chung*/ ma byin len pa'i dam tshig ni/ gzung ma mtshan ldan/ bkra shis skye bdun gyi bam/ gsang sngags sbas pa'i chos zab mo rnams ma byin len pa'o/ rdzun gyi dam tshig ni/ 66)dkon mchog gsum dang*/ slob dpon drug dang*/ mched lcam dang*/ sems can la gnod byed 'ong na/ gnad mi thang pa'i ched du gang babs kyi rdzun smra ba'o/ ngag rlang po'i tshig cub kyi dam tshig ni/ zhing bcu'am gdul bya mu rgod khong skran can rnams skrag cing dpa' skong ba'i tshig cub mo dang drag sngags kyi so rno so 'debs pa yin/ mi spang ba lnga ni 'dod chags bde stong*/ zhe sdang gsal stong*/ gti mug 'od gsal/ nga rgyal tshor stong*/ phrag dog gsal stong du lam du khyer/ mdor na lta ba dang*/ snying rje gnyis la 'dus/ dwangs du blad ba'i dam tshig lnga ni/ dri chen/ dri chu/ maṃ sa ste/ sha chen/ zil pa/ byang sems dkar po/ rakta ste/ byang sems dmar po grub pa bzhi yin par shes te/ nus pa'i mthu 67)yi grub pa ni/ dri chen gyi dug nad sel/ dri chus grang nad sel/ sha chen gyi mdze nad sel/ raktas 'brum nad sel/ byang sems kyi tsha nad sel/ byin gyis rlabs pas grub pa ni/ gtsang rmi tha dad du 'dzin pa'i sdig pa sbyong ba'i byin brlabs dang ldan/ ngo bos grub pa ni/ dri chen gyi tshe ring*/ dri chus skad snyan/ sha chen gyis mthu che/ raktas mdangs gsal/

byang sems kyis 'gro ba gzhan zim gyis gnon/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa ni/ dam rdzas lnga po la rigs lnga ye shes mngon sum du grub pa'i yon tan yod pas dang du blangs dgos kyang*/ phyag len la gong ma'i sgrub pa'i bdud rtsi chos sman la longs spyod rgyu yin lags/ de thams cad la bla ma dang yi dam mched lcam 68)kyis mi khrel ba gsum/ lta bsgom spyod 'bras bsdus pa'i tshul skabs su do ha'i dbyangs la drangs te/ a he ye/ nges bla ma brtan nas da lta'i bar/ mos gus dam tshig ltem brkyang med/ bla ma'i thugs kyi khrel mi gzigs/ khyed log lta mkhan tsho dgyes mdzod/ nges dbang bzhi thob nas bskyed rdzogs sbyangs/ tha mal snang zhen lha sku shar/ khong yi dam lha yi khrel mi dgos/ ma dag blo can tsho dgyes dgyes mdzod/ nges sdom pa zhus nas bag yod bskyangs/ nyes pa rmi lam mi dran na/ chos mdzad grogs kyi khrel mi gnang*/ khyod mchog 'dzin can tsho dgyes dgyes mdzod/ nges snyan brgyud gdams pa'i bdud rtsi thob/ don spros bral zab mo sems la bltas/ grub mtha' phyogs 'dzin zhig 69)nas thal/ phyogs ris can tsho dgyes dgyes mdzod/ nga kun bzang chos sku'i dgongs pa rtogs/ khyab gdal nam mkha'i 'khor yug la/ mnyam rjes gnyis po rdzun por gda'/ blun bsgom u tshug can tsho dgyes dgyes mdzod/ nges rang grol gnyug ma'i rgyal khams nyul/ gzung 'dzin gyi 'chings thag chad nas thal/ dag grol gyi tshul 'chos su yi bzos/ khyod gnyis 'dzin mkhan tsho dgyes dgyes mdzod/ nges gzhan don sangs rgyas bsgrub snyam kyang*/ don rang ngo 'khrul sangs nas 'dug sgrub mkhan gyi sems de dag nas song*/ khyod yid smon can tsho dgyes dgyes mdzod/ ces nyams mtshar ba'i mgur ma gang shes longs la nyams skyong mdzod/ ༈ yang lta bsgom 70)spyod pa'i nyams skyes pa'am/ nges med kyi ri khrod 'grim pa'i skabs su/ a la la mo la ye ye/

chos rdzogs chen gangs ri'i phrag shed na/ nyams rtogs kyi rtsal chen rdzogs pa dang*/ gzung 'dzin gyi chab la sbar mi 'khyags/ rnam rtog gi bu yug la nyam mi nga*/ bu zhig po'i snang tshul de ltar lags/ glu mchod pa 'bul lo bla ma'i tshogs/ thugs dgyes par dgongs sam mkha' 'gro ma/ lho tsan dan nags ma'i skyed tshal na/ bskyed rdzogs kyi 'dzom drug rgyas pa dang*/ nyams rtogs kyi zug kha 'grim zhing 'gro/ gzung 'dzin gyi 'phrang la dgos pa med/ bu zhig po'i snang tshul de ltar lags/ glu mchod pa 'bul lo bla ma'i tshogs/ thugs dgyes par dgongs sam mkha' 'gro ma/ mtho 71)nam mkha'i sprin gyis bla bre na/ snyan rgyud kyis rnga chen ldir ba dang*/ lung rig gi glog phreng gya ma gyu/ mar dgos mo'i snang bar zhe mi chags/ bu zhig po'i snang tshul de ltar lags/ glu mchod pa 'bul lo bla ma'i tshogs/ thugs dgyes par dgongs sam mkha' 'gro ma/ don kun ru dgongs pa'i dbyings rum nas/ 'od gsal gyi nyi zla shar ba yi/ sems sgra gcan gyi smag la ya mi nga*/ gzung 'dzin gyi sprin la khong mi 'jigs bu zhig po'i snang tshul de ltar lags/ glu mchod pa 'bul lo bla ma'i tshogs/ thugs dgyes par dgongs sam mkha' 'gro ma/ gnas ri khrod dben pa'i rgyal khab na/ gdengs bzhi yi glu chen 'bar ba dang*/ kun bzang chos sku'i rang 72)ngo la/ 'khrul pa gzung 'dzin sangs nas thal/ bu zhig po'i snang tshul de ltar lags/ glu mchod pa 'bul lo bla ma'i tshogs/ thugs dgyes par dgongs sam mkha' 'gro ma/ lho mon shing lo'i sdeb zhig na/ snyan rgyud kyi 'gyur khug len pa dang*/ dbyar dus bzang gi rgyal po'i pho nya yin/ sems bskyed par tshor sam rdo rje'i spun/ bu zhig po'i snang tshul de ltar lags/ glu mchod pa 'bul lo bla ma'i tshogs/ thugs dgyes par dgongs sam mkha' 'gro ma/ zhes 'gyur khug dal la snyan par 'thon/ 'di rnams kyis dpe brjod mdzad nas glu nyams la gang shar 'gogs med du blangs pas nyams rtogs bog 'don pa'i gnad du che'o/

༈ da ni mdo sngags gnyis ka'i lam gnad ma 73)'chugs pa rin chen byang chub kyi sems/ sems bskyed kyi skabs cung zad zhu na/ rgyal tshab byams pas/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'dod/ zhes zur gnyis sam don gnyis dang ldan pa byang chub sems kyi mtshan nyid yin pas/ zur dang po'i don dang po snying rjes sems can la dmigs pa/ zur phyi ma shes rab rdzogs byang la dmigs pa gnyis las/ dang po ji ltar bsgom na/ 'di la thun dang thun mtshams med par rgyud la ma skyes bar du bsgom dgos pas/ rang gi mdun du da lta'i ma rgan shi rung gson na yang gson gyi dus kyi phung khams skye mched ci lta ba bzhin rang la brtse sems dang bcas par bsam nas/ 'di ltar nam 74)mkhas gar khyab sems can gyi khyab las snang*/ sdug bsngal gyis khyab pa'i sems can thams cad da lta'i rang gis ma rgan 'di bzhin du ma ma byas pa med pas/ ma lan gcig byas pas mi tshad pa ma lan grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byas/ ma byas pa'i dus su drin chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskyang ba sha stag yin bsam nas/ dang po da lta'i rang gi ma rgan la yang ma shes pa/ drin dran pa/ drin gzo 'dod kyi bsam pa dang*/ sdug bsngal bral 'dod kyi snying rje bsgom pas/ dang po ma shes pa ni/ da res kyi ma rgan 'dis da lta'i ma byas par ma zad lan grangs bsam gyis mi khyab par ma byas/ tshul ni/ lung gis sgrubs na/ mdo las/ ma yi thugs mtha' rgya shug tshig dgu tsam/ ril bu dril kyang sa 75)yi long mi 'gyur/ zhes pa rnams thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pas gzigs nas/ da lta'i ma 'di'i mi zhig gis ma byas pa nas bzungs te/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa'i bar du sems can mi 'dra ba du ma'i ma byas tshul rnams gzigs nas/ re re bzhin du gsung nas bdag gis sa chen po 'di rgya shug tshig dgu'i tshad du dril nas ril bu bgrangs na/

sa chen po 'di zad par 'gyur gyi/ ma gcig po des ma byas pa'i mtha' zad par mi 'gyur ba dang*/ rigs pas sgrub na/ bdag 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas 'khor ba 'di 'khyams dus sa lag pa'i mthil tsam zhig gi steng nas lan grangs bsam gyis mi khyab par skye ma myong sa dang 'chi ma myong sa med pas/ lha dang dmyal ba phar cher 76)rdzus skyes yin ma gtogs/ gzhan thams cad ma med par skyes mi shes pas ma lan grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byas ma gcig gi ma brgyud mar byas pa'ang ma yin pas/ dgra gnyen bar ma gsum nges pa med par ma byas/ de'i nang nas ma byas par bsam pa ni mar shes pa yin/ de nas drin dran pa la 'jig rten pa dang chos kyi lugs kyi drin dran tshul gyi dang po la/ lus bskyed pa'i drin ni rang gi rnam par shes pa dri za nye bar len pa'i rnam shes 'khyam po zhig ma'i mngal du zhugs nas zla ba dgu ngo dang bcu yi bar du dka' tshegs dang sdug bsngal thams cad la mas bzod nas/ mas kha zas zos pa'i dngas ma bu'i lta ba nas brgyud de dper na mar me la sdong skya bzhag pa bzhin du bskyed tshul bsam pa yin/ de bas srog 77)sbyin pa'i drin ni/ rang nyid phyir btsas 'i dus shi po yin na srog ma chad pa/ gson po yin na mgo mi khyogs pa zhig ma yi bdag po ma byas na ja yun gcig gi shi 'gro rgyu zhig yin pa la/ ma rgan gyis a ma la bu skyes byung snyams pa'i dga' spro dang bcas nas/ phru ma byus/ lte thag bcad/ 'o ma'i chu rgyun dron mos bkrus nas/ lag sor mo bcu'i rtse la g.yengs nas/ 'chi rgyu 'chi ma bcug rul rgyu skams ma bcug pa srog sbyin pa'i drin yin no/ de nas yo byad bstabs pa'i drin ni/ bar do'i rnam shes 'khyams po kha la zas med/ rgyab la gos med/ lag na nor med/ snga ltas byas na gar thon ma shes/ phyi ltas byas na 'gro drug gi 78)gnas ga nas 'ong mi shes pa zhig la ma drin mo ches zas kyi dang po mdar ba'i nu zho bsnun/

gos kyi dang po sha drod la bcar de nas zas kyi phud byin/ gos kyi rtse mos g.yog 'grang ltog lag pas byugs/ zas khas snyod/ mi gtsang ba la lag pas phyis/ snab lus kha yi gzhib nas skyed bsrong nas ma rgan gyi sdug bsngal gtam ngan thams cad khyad du bsad/ bsad nas bsags pa'i nor longs spyod thams chad bu la byin/ bu 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po lta bus bed la bkod nus na yang da dung sems ma tshim pa'i bar gyi yo byad thams cad byin pa ni yo byad bstabs pa'i drin yin/ 'jig rten bstan pa'i drin ni/ za mi shes pa la za lob/ 'thung mi shes pa la 'thung bslab/ 'gro lugs/ 'dug stongs/ gtam smra 79)tshul dang*/ a ma dang*/ a pha gyis dang yan chad nas bslabs/ gos kyi gyon lugs dang*/ ske rag gi sgrog tshul dang*/ lham sgrog gi dam slod yan chad bslab nas su dang mi mnyam pa med pa/ mnyam gnyis gang gis rgyal po byed nas/ mdor na chung ba phur bu tsam pa de chen po g.yag shad tsam pa zhig gi bar du ma yi drin gyi bskyangs tshul rnams dran par bya/ de nas chos kyi lugs kyi drin ni/ dal 'byor bco brgyad dang ldan pa'i lus rin po che zhes 'bod du rung ba 'di mas bskyed/ rang gi nus na/ tshe gcig lus gcig gi steng nas sangs rgyas sgrub rung ba 'di yang mas bskyed/ gzhan yang ma sems can de med na/ dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa med/ de med na bar du 80)rgyal sras kyi spyod pa sbyin pa sbyin yul/ tshul khrims srung yul/ bzod par bsgom yul yang med la/ de med na mthar sangs rgyas thob rgyu med tshul gyi chos dang 'jig rten gnyis ka lugs kyi drin dran dgos/ de nas drin bzo 'dod ni/ da ga re sngar ma rgan gyi nga'i skyid sdug la bltas nas khe dang rgyal kha thams cad bu la byin/ gyong dang bub kha thams cad ma rang gis blangs ba yin 'dug pas/ da res nga chos pa byang chub sems dpa'i ming thog zhig re bas ma rgan gyi skyid sdug la ngas lta dgos bsam pa dang*/

drin lan zhig bsab dgos snyams pa'i blo dung dung ba ma skyes bar du bsgom/ de ltar drin bzo 'dod kyi blo de skyes pa nas/ sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod kyi snying rje bsgom pa ni/ da ngas ma rgan gyi skyid sdug la ngas lta 81)ba la babs pas/ ma rgan de bde ba la myong gi dang*/ sdug bsngal myong gi yod khi 'dod rgyu ci 'dod kyi yod bsam na/ 'dod rgyu bde ba 'dod na nyin mtshan gcig nang ja zhim po phor pa gang 'thung nas bzung ste/ mngon mtho'i bde ba thams cad 'dod kyang*/ bde ba'i rgyu dge ba ni rang gi sgrub mi shes/ tshul bzhin du ston pa po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhig ni med/ gal te yod na de'i bka' bzhin du ni mi sgrub pas/ zhi ba lhas/ bde ba 'dod kyang gti mug pas/ rang gi bde ba dgra ltar 'joms/ zhes dang*/ bde ba'i rgyu dge ba ni dgra mi sha bo mthong ba ltar gzhom pas ma rgan bde ba'i rgyu dad pa dang*/ nges 'byung byang chub kyi sems dang ni mi ldan/ bde ba'i 'bras bu mngon 82)mtho nas sangs rgyas kyi bde ba dang mi ldan byams pa'i dmigs pa'i yul/ rnam pa blo bde ba rgyu 'bras gnyis dang ldan par gyur cig ldan na ci ma rung*/ ldan pa zhig ngas bya'o snyams nas ma rgan bde ba dang rgyu 'bras gnyis dang ldan pa'i ched du/ spyod 'jug gis/ bla rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon/ 'gro ba skyabs pa'i sogs kyis gsol ba 'debs/ de nas ma rgan gyi sdug bsngal mi 'dod kyang*/ dper na me stag gcig phog pa'am tsher ma gcig zug pa'i sdug bsngal mi 'dod par/ a tsha tsha zer nas 'bros dgos na/ yang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba la 'chol nyog tu nyin mtshan med par spyod pas/ zhi ba lhas/ sdug bsngal mi 'dod sems yod kyang*/ sdug bsngal nyid la mngon par rgyug zhes dang*/ 83)'bras bu sdug bsngal mi 'dod kyang*/ 'dod pa'i yul lnga la chags shing zhen pa'i dbang gis nyon mongs pa'i mthu rgyas te sdug bsngal du 'jug pa ni/

phye ma leb mar me'i 'od kyis gzug la 'dod nas phyin pas tshig sa dang*/ ri dwags gling bu'i sgra la chags shing nyan pas bsad pa dang*/ bung ba sbrang rtsi'i 'byung gnas me tog 'jibs pas 'byar ba'am kha zum nas shi ba dang*/ nya rnams nya pa'i lcags kyu'i rtse'i zas kyi ros bslus te bsad pa dang*/ glang po che bsil ba'i rig bya 'dod nas mtshor zhugs pas shi ba lta bu ste/ do ha mdzod kyi glu las/ srid pa'i phyag rgyas 'gro ba ma lus bslus/ zhes dang*/ kye ho rmongs rnams mda' bsnun gyis smras pa/ nya dang phye leb glang chen bung ba dang*/ 'dir ni ri dwags bzhin du blta bar byos 84)zhes so/ yul lnga po las nyon mongs pa skye zhing de'i dbang gi 'khor ba mtha' med par 'khyams te/ nyin mtshan med par lus kyis las na sdig pa/ ngag gis bshad na sdig pa/ sems kyi bsam na yang sdig pa las med pas byed rgyu sdig pa la 'ong rgyu sdug bsngal las med pa las/ skye ba snga ma'i sdug bsngal gyis ded/ da lta'i sdug bsngal gyis bsu ma byed/ skye ba phyi ma'i sdug bsngal la mtshams sbyar/ sdug bsngal gyi bden pas dngos su gnod/ kun 'byung gi bden pas brgyud de mnar ba'i ma rgan sdug bsngal can de snying rje'i dmigs pa'i yul rnam pa blo sdug bsngal de dang bral 'dod kyi bsam pa skye ba yin/ ma rgan de lta bu'i sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral bar gyur cig snyams pa smon pa dang 'brel ba/ sdug 85)bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral na ci ma rung snyams pa 'dun pa dang 'brel ba/ bral ba zhig bdag gi bya'o snyams pa'i dam bca' dang 'brel ba gsum ldan sdug bsngal dang bral ba'i ched du dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs pa rnams/ zur snga ma bsgom tshul yin/ da sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis po de dang bral nas gang la 'god dgos bsam na/ mtho ris kyi tshangs pa dang brgya byin lta bu'i go 'phang la bkod na sngar yag ma rgan rang gi yang de 'dra ba mang po thob kyang mi rtag

nyan rang dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang la bkod kyang*/ 'khor ba las thar ba yin kyang byang chub sems dpa'i sa'i yon tan dang sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu'i yon tan gang yang med pas/ da ni skyon kun zang yon tan rdzogs rnam pa thams 86)cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa la bkod dgos/ de'i nus pa da lta bdag la mi 'dug pas/ 'gro kun sgrol nus pa/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de sems can thams cad kyi don la dang po bdag gis thob par bya snyams nas yang yang bsgom/ de nas rim pa bzhin du pha dang*/ spun zla dang*/ yul mi dang*/ 'dzam gling dang*/ thun 'jog khar nam mkha'i mtha' khyab kyi sems can la bsgom/ rtsa ba'i ma nas ma bsgom na snying rje'i gol sa gshis 'byams go yul du shor ba zhes pa'i gegs 'ong ba yin/ de thams cad yang bsdus te/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gis sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dge sbyor 'di bsgrub po snyams du dge ba thams cad bsam pa des 87)zin par byed pa de sbyor ba sems bskyed dam pa yin/ bka' gdams pa'i man ngag las/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin lta bu'i go 'phang thob kyang sems can gyi don byed mi nus/ nyan rang dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob kyang sems can gyi don chen po byed mi nus/ byang chub sems dpa' sa bcu'i rgyun mtha' na bzhugs pa'i rgyal tshab byams mgon lta bu'i go 'phang thob kyang sems can nyung du re'i don las byed mi nus/ sems can thams cad kyi don gcig char du mdzad pa sangs rgyas las med pas de dang po sems can gyi don du rang gis sgrub dgos/ gsung pas 'di sems bskyed mtshan nyid pa yin/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas la dang po 'god 'dod de/ deng sang gi mi shes pa tshos bsngags 88)brjod chen po byed kyang*/ sems bskyed kyi dbye ba yin/ mtshan nyid pa mi sar go dgos/ slob spring las/ gang gis ltod ma nyal ba'i sems de med na/

skye shis 'phos pa'i ngo ma shes pa de bor nas/ gal te gcig thar byed na de las khrol bor med/ shin tu ma rab zhig na'ang spong ba su zhig spro/ zhes gsung pa'i don la bsam mo/ jo bo yab sras zhus lan las/ blo ldan snying rje chen po nga la gson/ nga yi pha ma la la khwa tas zos/ nga yi pha ma la la khro chur byin/ sdug bsngal mi bzod thang bros gyur kyang*/ thang 89)chen spu gris gtam pa'i lam du song*/ de la'ang rab tu skrag te bros gyur kyang*/ bsil nags 'khrugs te ril gri rab tu snyil/ gzhan yag gos med grangs bas rab tu gdung*/ a chu rab tu chu bur rab tu rdol/ padma ltar gas utpal bzhin du gas/ de res nga yi pha ma de 'dra ba'i/ mi gcig pha ma mo dong lhung gyur na/ snying yod mi bzod snyams la 'phar rtse na/ nga yi pha mas de 'dre bzod lags sam/ nga yi pha ma gos med skam pa dag zas med mgrin phra lto ba rab tu che/ yan lag phra zhing stobs med gyur pa rnams/ ji ltar bzod dam 'brom rje de la som/ gti mug gyur pa'i pha mar bltas na yang*/ dbang med gyur pas sdug 90)bsngal rnams kyis gtsos/ phal chen rang sha dgra bo lang nas phung*/ la la spu lpags sha rus dgra bor lang*/ la la rang stob khur chen dgra bor lang*/ la la mgyogs pas bkol te dgra bor lang*/ la la dbang med 'byung bzhi'i sdug bsngal gyur/ pha ma de 'dra bzod dam 'brom rjes som/ e ma mthor ris bde skyid zhes grags pa/ drangs por skyes pa'i lus ni rgur por gyur/ nag por skyes pa'i skra ni dkar po gyur/ dkar ser dmar mdangs 'jam zhing gnyer med pa/ sngo skem gnyer mang la sogs rab tu nyams/ kun gyis yid khar mi 'ong pha rol nye/ bskyang ba'i bus kyang sdang mig lta byed na/ de yang mi rtag pha rol 'gro ba sogs/ bzod dam snying nas de la bsam pa rigs/ 'brel 91)glag med do 'khor ba ma stongs bar/ pha ma'i duḥkha kho bos bskyang du gsol/

zhes pas/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ pha ma la snying rje bsgoms pas dkyus gcig tu bsgom pa 'di lan ngag khyad par can yin pas yag yang bsgom 'tshal lo/ ༈ dge rtsa rkyen gyis mi 'jigs pa dngos gzhi dmigs med dam pa ni/ dge rtsa khong khro dang*/ 'gyod pa dang*/ ma bsngos pa dang*/ ngom pa dang bzhis/ mi zad par byed pa phyag rdzogs dbu gsum gyi lta bas zin dgos pa la/ rdzogs chen gyi lta bas zin pas chog las dang po pas blo sbyang na/ dang po tshig don de blo la len pa dang*/ de nas de'i don la yang nas yang du bsam la dpyad pas dpyad bsgom yin/ des sems 92)skyo na dmigs pa zhig la sems rtse gcig par 'jog pa ni 'jog sgom yin/ zhi ba lhas/ dmigs pa la ni brten nas su/ mi dmigs pa dag rab tu skye/ zhes so/ mjug bsngo ba dam pa 'di thun gyi rjes thams cad la dgos pas/ de ltar thun nang de dpyad sgom dang 'jog sgom gyi dge bas mtshon/ rang gi dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba thams cad blos gcig tu bsdus shing sdom nas rang gzhan sems can thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob pa'i ched du bsngo/ bsngo ba'i tshul de yang sangs rgyas dang bcas pas 'khor gsum yongs dag gi bsngo bas ji ltar bsngos pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang yongs su bsngo bar bgyi'o bsam nas/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo ji ltar 93)mkhyen pa dang*/ kun tu bzang po= sogs brjod/ de nas thun har lang byed nas rgyug mi 'gro bar/ da ga re ngas thun nang de nas blo sbyong ci tsam la sems 'di pha rol gyi yul la shor ram ma shor bsam nas brtags dpyad zhig byed dgos/ brtags dpyad byed pas res 'ga' thun nang de nas dge ba sha stag bsam nyan nas thun legs po zhig chod yod na des sems nga rgyal skyes 'ong na rang skyon ci yod kyi mtshangs nas dran par byas te/ nga rgyal de bcag dgos/

yang res 'ga' thun nang de nas blo sbyong gcig bsam kha mi nyan nas sems 'khrul pa'i yul la song nas thun bcad rgyu de don med du shor na sems sdug nas da ngas ci 'ong pa mi 'dug snyams nas sems spro shi dus e khyod de 'dra zhig yin pas rgyu mtshan gyis dal 94)'byor rnyed pa dka' ba sogs nas blo sbyong dgos pa red ma gtogs/ dang po nas mi yengs mi 'khrul ba zhin yin na de 'dra dgos dgos med bsam nas/ thun phyi ma'i nang de nas sems ngan khyod ngas 'khrul pa'i dbang du gtong re bsam dgos/ theg pa che chung gnyis ka'i lugs la sems ha cang nga rgyal che ba dang*/ zhum che ba gnyis ka'i rgyud la lam shes mi skye bar/ sems mnyam pa zhig gi rgyud la lam shes skyed bar gsungs/ ༈ da ni bskyed rdzogs kyi gnad cung zad zhu na/ rgyas pa ni rang re'i tshe 'khyol na/ rgyas par rjes nas zhu ba'i rten 'byung du bzhag nas/ 'dir ni nyams len gyi gnad ngas pa res 'chad na/ spyir sngags pa lha lam pa zhes yongs su grags pas/ bskyed rim tsam gal chung dang*/ 95)don mde du mi bsam par lha lan gcig tsam yid la gsal na/ spyir sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i tshogs rdzogs/ yi dam lha'i gsal snang gis bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs/ de la bden med kyi lta bas zin pas ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs tshul phur pa zhe sdang khros pa'i rgyud sogs las gsung pas/ bskyed rim gyi skye ba'i bag chags sbyangs/ rdzogs rim gyi 'chi ba'i bag chags sbyang nas sangs rgyas sgrub pa spyir btang nas/ lha bskyed pa'i skabs rang gi lus ngag yid gsum bya ba dang bcas pa lha ye shes pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas par byed pa yin pas/ dang po de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi skabs su rig pa spyi blugs su 'jog pa/ zhes rig pa la mnyam bzhag thun gcig byed/ de nas 96)snying rje chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la/

de ltar sems can thams cad sangs rgyas pa'i rang bzhin rnam dag yin pa yin la ma rtogs pa 'khrul pa'i dbang gis 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi dbang med du mnar ba rnams la snying rje dung dung bar bsgom/ rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi skabs su/ ngo bo stong pa nyid/ gdangs snying rje chen po/ rnam pa rgyu'i yi ge hūṃ yig la sogs pa'i rnam par yun ring du bsgom nas/ rgyu'i yi ge hūṃ de las 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa'i sa bon rim par 'phros te bsgom/ gzhal yas khang bsgom tshar ba dang*/ rgyu'i yi ge de pho brang de'i tog gi rtse mo nas gdan la bya rgod gzan la babs pa bzhin du babs nas/ 'od du zhu ba las gtso bo yab yum gnyis bsgom/ de gnyis kyi sbyor 97)mtshams nas 'khor thams cad spros te bsgom/ lha de yang rdo rje chos bdun dang ldan pa sra ba brtan pa/ mi chod pa/ mi shig pa'i rnam par/ snang ba'i cha nas spyan gyi dkar nag shags sbub kyi mtho dman ba spu'i khung bu yan chad nas ma 'dres par gsal thebs par bsgom/ gu ru rin po ches phur ṭig 'bum nag las/ de ltar sra sra 'thas su bsgom mo/ zhes gsung pas so/ sgyu ma dang chu zla lta bu zhig bsgom pas bskyed rim gyi go mi chod/ gzung rnams ltar shar/ 'dzin rnams stong nyid du zhugs pa zhig sngags kyi khyad chos yin/ tshogs gnyis kyang 'di 'dra bas rdzogs pa yin/ deng sang sgyu ma dang rmi lam lta bu zhig dgos zer mkhan mang te gnad ma go ba'i 'khyar gtam bya ba 98)yin/ 'di dus na tha mal ma dag pa'i snang ba dang*/ de la zhen pa'i snang zhen gnyis kyi gnyen po lha'i rnam pa gsal zhing phyi snod zhing khams gnas gzhal yas khang*/ lus lhar gsal bas kyang*/ zhen tsul la dngos por zhen pa dang*/ bdag tu zhen pa gnyis yod pas/ dngos por zhen pa'i gnyen por gzhal yas khang*/ byang chub mchog gi chos sum cu so bdun gyi rang bzhin dang*/

lha zhal gsum sku gsum/ phyag gnyis thabs dang shes rab/ zhabs bzhi tshad med bzhi/ yab thabs snang ba'i ngo bo/ yum shes rab stong pa nyid kyi mtshon/ don gyi dag pa dran/ bdag tu zhen pa'i gnyen po/ res 'ga' lha'i rnam pa gsal/ lha ye shes pa dngos yin bsam/ res 'ga' ma 99)gsal na/ lha ye shes pa'i thugs ye shes chen po zhing khams dang gzhal yas khang dang*/ gtso 'khor gyi rnam pa shar tshul dang*/ de'i sems kyi gnas lugs/ ye shes chen po gnas lus longs spyod kyi rnam par shar ba la bzang ngan dang khyad par med bsam nas chos nyid kyi nga rgyal dran pa 'di snga 'gyur ba'i khyad chos bla na med pa de yin/ nges par bskyed rim de ltar bsgom pas yul gsum gyad du gyur pa zhes/ dang po rang gi blo ngo na rang lhar 'char bar du lha'i rgyan sogs rang gi reg pa'i yul du gyur/ tha ma gzhan gyi mthong ngo na lha 'char dus bar du bsgom/ de nas sngags bzla dgos/ dang po bzla rgyu zhig rgyad don ma yin yang gong ma'i phyag bzhes la 'byung gi 'dug bskyed rim 100)gyi gsal snangazin dus sems zhi gnas grub nas las su rung ba khyad par can thob/ de dus zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las bsgrub na sngags bzlas pa la mi ltos pa zhig 'byung ba yin/ lha bsgom rgyu de la bskyed rim lha'i gzer zhes gsung*/ rang gi sems dang lha ye shes pa'i thugs gnyis su med pa sdom pa/ dgongs pa mi 'gyur chos kyi gzer ni/ de ltar bskyed rim bsgom pa'i dus na/ rang rig ljon pa'i ye shes des rtsis zin par byed pa yin/ bzlas pa sngags kyi gzer ni/ lha de la gsal snang thon nges pa zhig 'ong dus/ de'i thugs kar sems dpa' sum brtsegs su ting 'dzin sems dpa' hūṃ yig la sogs pa'i mthar sngags phreng gsal nas lha sngags sems gsum dbyer med pa ngo bo 101)gicag gi rang bzhin du bzla ba yin/ rang gi bya ba phrin las kyi ngo bor dag par bya ba ni/

'phro 'du phrin las kyi gzer/ 'od zer spro bsdu bya ba rnams yin/ de tsam rgyas par ma lcog na rdzogs chen ngo sprod kyi gnad rnams dran par byas te rig pa'ie shes chen po'i rtsal rol pa rgyan 'char tshul du/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad gzhal yas khang du gyur pa dang*/ nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad lha dang lha mo'i rol pa/ sgra grags thams cad sngags kyi rol pa/ dran rtogs thams cad thugs ye shes kyi rol par blta zhing*/ lha bsgom sngags bzlas na go chod gi 'dug de ma yin par tha mal rang rgyud kyi snang ba gzhir bzhag gi steng nas ngag 'khyal dang 'dres pa'i zhor la 102)phreng nag rgyu ma bda' bda' byed nas mtshams dang bsnyen pa'i go chod par rloms pa la snying po ci yang yod pa ma yin no/ ༈ de nas rlung gi rdzogs rim bsgom dgos pas/ rlung gi rgyud lung man ngag gsum ka'i nyams len thun mongs pa yin pas/ rgyu mtshan bskyed rim gyi zhi gnas 'grub nas/ ma dag pa'i snang zhen khegs kyang yul gsum gyad du gyur pa'i gya nom lhar zhen mi khegs pas/ de 'od gsal du 'gogs dgos pa dang sems kyi gzhon pa lta bu de rlung yin pas de la rang dbang thob na sems la rang dbang thob/ de thob na rlung med pa'i mar me gsal ba bzhin lhag mthong 'od gsal la brtan pa thob nas/ mthong lam chos nyid kyi bden pa mthong*/ de'i ngo skal du gyur pa'i nyon mongs pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad 103)byang ba'i dgos pa dang*/ nang 'byung ba lnga'i rlung la rang dbang thob dus/ phyi rol gyi 'byung ba lnga la rang dbang bsgyur nas/ mngon shes dang*/ rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan rnams 'byung ba'i dgos pa yod pas brtson pas nyams su len dgos/ 'di bsgom dus/ lus chos bdun grim cha than pa byed/ phyi lus kyi stong ra lha rang gi lus tshad zhig dar dmar gyi phru ma phus brgyang ba lta bu zhig bsgom/

de'i lus kyis dbus drang por na lte ba'i spu nag gu'i mtshams yan nas rtsa dbu ma mtshan nyid bzhi dang ldan pa rang gi srin lag gi phra sbom tsam sngo shad de spyi gtsug gi bar du zug pa yar sne kha zum g.yas g.yon gnyis na ro rkyang gnyis gro sog gi sbu gu tsam sna bug gnyis nas rna ltag nas mgrin 104)pa'i nang nas mar dbu ma'i g.yas g.yon gnyis nas mar drangs sha de brgyud nas mar sne lte 'og tu dbu ma'i nang du chud pa yi ge cha yi 'phang lo lta bu bsgoms pa/ nang rtsa'i stong ra yin/ gsang ba rlung sems kyi stong ra ni/ dbu ma'i dbus snying gi thad du dngas ma lnga ldan gyi thig le rma bya'i sgro thig lta bu'i dbus su yi dam gyi thugs srog hūṃ la sogs pa'am/ spyi khyab tsam du āḥyig dkar po zhig bsgom/ dang po rlung ro dgu krugs sam sum sprug gcig 'bud/ de dus g.yas ra mo nas 'dod chags kyi rlung kha dgos dmar po/ g.yon rkyang ma nas zhe sdang gi rlung kha dgos dkar po/ dbus dbu ma nas gti mug gi rlung nag po zhig rnam par phyir song bar bsam la ha sprug kyang bya/ de'i rjes su rlung dngos gzhi bsgom pa la 105)rlung sbyar ba bzhi ldan gyi man ngag gsar rnying thams cad dgongs pa mthun pas/ lag pa rdo rje'i khur tshur pus mo gnyis kyi steng du bzhag nas/ gzhu ltar dgugs pa ni/ sna nas rlung dal bu'i nang du rngub/ de dus dmigs pa/ sa rlung ser po gru bzhi/ chu rlung dkar po zlum po/ me rlung dmar po zla gam/ rlung gi rlung ljang gu gzhu brdung ba'i rnam pa/ nam mkha'i rlung mthing ka spos dud lta bu bsgom na chog min na 'byung ba lnga'i rlung gi dwangs ma kha dogs lnga ldan snye cham sne tshon dril ba'am gzung thag gi rnam pa lta bu zhig bsgom nas/ sna bug gnyis nas zhugs/ ro rkyang gnyis nas brgyud dbu ma'i nang du zhugs/ snying ga'i a yig la thim par bsam nas steng rlung lte 'og tu mnan/

'og rlung yar 106)cung zad bskum nas lte 'og tu kha sbyar du bzung nas lte 'og ther gyis rlung gi brgyang ba la thum pa ltar dgang ba zer/ de nas rgya mdud ltar chings su sdom pa ni/ g.yas g.yon du pho skor lan gsum re byas nas/ mi thub pa dang*/ sna bug gnyis nas rlung lhag gam ma lus par mda' ltar 'phen pa yin/ de dag la sbyor ba bzhi ldan zhes gzhu ltar dgugs pa dang gcig bum pa ltar dgang ba dang gnyis/ rgya mdud ltar chings su sdom pa dang gsum/ mda' ltar 'phen pa dang bzhi la sbyor ba bzhi ldan zhes gsungs so/ thig le rdzogs rim ni/ rtsa yur ba lta bu la/ thig le chu lta bur 'khrid pa las/ rlung gi rdzogs rim me lta bu 'di la brtan pa ma thob bar bshad pa don cher med/ sbyor ba bzhi ldan gyi rdzogs rim 'di la byang dus rlungs 107)sems dbu mar thim pa'i rtags bcu'i stong gzugs dang*/ stong bzhi'i drang pa'i 'od gsal yul sems kyi bslad pa dang bral bar 'char ba yin no/ 'di nas rdzogs chen ka lhun gnyis ka'i gnad cig zhus pa ni/ phyin chad khyed la snying nas gus pas bla mar 'dzin cing chos rnam dag don du gnyer ba tshe 'di la zhe mi chags pa re gnyis 'ong ba srid pa dang*/ nyid la thugs dam gsal 'debs kyi dgos pa yod pa'i phyir/ rdzogs chen la/ gzhi rdzogs pa chen po/ lam rdzogs pa chen po/ 'bras bu rdzogs pa chen po dag gsum bzhugs pa'i/ gzhi ni sems can rkang gnyis rkang bzhi rkang mang la sogs pa sems can shes rgyud kyis bsdus pa thams cad yin/ gzhi'i gnas lugs ni/ sems can de dag 108)re re'i rang rgyud nas sems kyi bab sam/ gshis sam/ 'dug tshul/ ngo bo bab dang chos nyid zhes/ ngo bo stong pa/ rang bzhin gsal ba/ thugs rje kun khyab kyi ye shes rnam gsum dbyer med chen por bzhugs pa la ming btags na/ ngo bo ye dag gi sangs rgyas/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi sangs rgyas/gzhi lhun grub kyi sangs rgyas zhes rgyal ba sku gsum gyi ye shes dang thams cad ma btsal ye rdzogs su bzhugs yod pa/

de rtogs bya yin/ lam rdzogs pa chen po la/ smin byed dbang dang grol byed gdams pa'i rim pa gnyis bzhugs pa'i smin byed kyi dbang ni/ 'og ma/ ma hā/ a nu gnyis kyi dbang bzhi tshig dbang rin po ches khyad par du byas pa'i rdzogs chen rang gis khyad chos spros 109)bcas/ spros med/ rab tu spros med/ shin tu spros med kyis dbang gis rgyud smin dgos/ nang rgyud gsum gar bum pa gsang ba shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dang*/ tshig dbang dang bzhi re gsung pa/ dag bya sgo gsum bya ba dang bcas pa dag nas/ 'bras bu sku bzhi'i ngo bo smin pa dang*/ gnas skabs lam bzhi bsgom pa la dbang byed pas na/ dbang bzhi'i rgyud smin nas dam tshig rnam par dag pas rgyud bsdom nas/ grol byed kyi gdams pa nyams su len dgos/ dbang bskur thob pa ma byas par sngags kyi chos 'chad nyan byed pa la rnam smin ngan song las 'gro sa med/ 'bras bu rdzogs pa chen po ni/ rdzogs chen gyi lta ba rtogs/ bsgom pas goms/ spyod pas 110)bog dbyung nas/ sems kyi gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin dri ma thams cad dang bral nas mngon du gyur dus 'bras bu zhes bya bas/ 'bras bu de thob bya/ gzhi de togs bya'am shes bya yin pas/ da res/ lam rdzogs pa chen po'i grol byed kyi gnasamapa bshad pa'i skabs yin pas/ de la gsum/ sngon 'gro sems kyi khang bu bshigs pa/ dngos gzhi rig pa rang ngo sprod pa/ rjes nyams kyi skyong tshul bstan pa dang gsum la/ dang po/ nang gses sems kyi rtsad bcad pa/ mtshang btsal ba la/ thun mong pa sems byung gnas 'gro gsum gyi brtags pa gsum gyi brtags dgos pas/ lta ba de la dbye na/ yid dpyod kyi lta ba dang*/ mdo sngags thun mong gi lta ba dang*/ chos nyid kyi lta ba'am/ mnyam 111)gzhag ye shes kyi lta ba gnyis kyi/ dang po/ yid dpyod kyi lta ba/ mig lta bu'i/ yul sems kyi byung gnas 'gro gsum rang bzhin med pa bden med du nges pa yin pas/

dang po/ rtsad bcad pa ni/ 'khor 'das thams cad kyi rtsa ba sems kyis byas pa yin par shes nas/ sems de gzhi med rtsa bral du gtan la phab nas/ gnas lugs rtogs dgos pas/ 'di brtags tshul la thun dang*/ thun mtshams phye nas thun gyi nang nas brtags dgos pas/ thun gyi dngos gzhi la/ da bdag 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas 'khor ba 'dir 'khyams shing*/ 'khor ba ni rigs drug gi gnas 'di dang*/ 'khor mkhan gang zag gi bdag rang dbang med par 'khor bas/ da rang gi rgyud 'di tshur bsdu na/ lus 112)ngag yid gsum ste sgo gsum la 'du bas/ 'khor ba'i rgyu bsags mkhan gyi gtso bo de sgo gsum gyi gang gtso bor red bsam nas/ ngag sems gnyis la ma ltos pa'i lus yan gar bas las bsags mi shes la/ shi ba'i ro dang 'dra/ lus sems gnyis la ma ltos pa'i ngag kho nas las bsags mi shes/ lus ngag gnyis la ma ltos pa'i sems kho nas las bsags mi shes par dpyad la/ 'on kyang lus ngag yid gsum 'tshogs nas las bsags pa yin par shes nas 'di la gang gtso che bsam na/ sems rgyal po lta bu'i gtso bo yin tshul dang*/ lus ngag gnyis bran g.yogs lta bu'i sgo nas ji ltar bsags na/ sems 'dod chags dang zhe sdang gti mug gsum gyi dbang du song nas/ mi dge ba bcu yis 113)las bsags pas na/ chen pos dmyal ba'i gnas su skye ba dang*/ 'bring gis yi dwags su skye ba/ tha mas dud 'gror skye ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad myong dgos pa'i rtsa ba 'di sems zhen pa dang bcas pas las bsags pas lan 'dug de bzhin du sems kyi rgyu 'bras yid ches kyi dad pas kun nas bslangs te/ dge ba bcu yi tshul khrims dang*/ mchod sbyin dang*/ mi g.yo ba bsam gtan bzhi dang*/ gzugs med bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin sgrub na/ mtho ris lha dang mi'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyu sgo gsum 'tshogs nas byed kyang gtso bo de sems yin par thag bcad/ thar pa dag thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang zhig sgrub na yang sems nges 'byung dang byang chub sems kyis skyes nas/

114)lus ngag gnyis kyi de'i grogs byed nas/ tshul khrims dang*/ ting nge 'chin dang*/ shes rab kyi bslab pa dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod nas/ rdzogs smin sbyang ba mthar phyin nas sangs rgyas thob pa yang*/ sems gtso che tshul rnams zhib sar go brda sprad nas brtags bcug dgos pas/ mdor na/ 'khor ba mtho dman gyi snang ba thams cad sems ma dag pas snang*/ log pa'i 'khrul snang 'ba' zhig pa yin pa dang*/ thar pa dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i snang ba thams cad yang*/ dag pa'i bzang snang 'ba' zhig pa kho na yin par thag chod pa sems kyi rtsad chod par yin no/ gnyis pa/ de lta bu'i sgo gsum 'tshogs pa dang bcas pa'i sgo nas las bsags kyang*/ sgo gsum 115)po de res 'ga' gcig red bsam/ res 'ga' tha dad red bsam nas 'dzin pa ni mtshang ngam skyon yin pas/ de yod med brtags pa la mtshang btsal ba zhes bya bas/ dang po/ sgo gsum gcig e yin brtags na gcig min te/ lus ngag gnyis la mthong thos yod pa ltar sems la mthong thos su rung ba yin min brtags na/ lus la mthong rgyu dang brdog pa sogs yod pa/ ngag la thos rgyu yod pa bzhin/ sems e mthong ltos dang mi mthong*/ rna bas nyon dang mi tshor/ phug na sems la mthong thos med par ltar/ lus ngag gnyis la mthong thos med dgos pas/ de ltar brtags pas/ sgo gsum po gcig min par go/ tha dad red bsam na/ tha dad rgyu'i 116)chas ma grub ste/ lus ngag yid gsum po 'das pa 'gags nas ma grub/ ma 'ongs pa ma skyes zhing ma thob pa mo gshams kyi bu mo bzhin du ma grub/ da lta ba skyes pa'i nub mo nas bzung*/ byis pa gzhon nu'i dus dang*/ dar la bab pa dang*/ rgan po rgas shing 'khogs pa'i bar du snga ma snga ma mi rtag par phyi ma phyi mar rim pa bzhin du 'gyur zhing rags par 'gyur bas mi rtag phra ba skad cig gcig gis rgyur 'gyur nas chu rgyun gyis skye 'gags bzhin du 'gyur bas phra ba chos nyid kyi mi rtag pa/

de'i skad cig da lta ba la snga phyi'i cha phyes pas/ da lta ba zhes pa yang ma grub pas tha dad rgyu'i chos med par kho thag chod par bya/ gsum pa/ sems kyi byung gnas 'gro gsum la spyir brtags dang*/ thun 117)mong ma yin yul can sems kyi gshis lugs la brtags nas gnas lugs 'od gsal chen po gtan la dbab pa gnyis kyi/ dang po la/ da 'khor ba'i rtsa ba sems yin/ sems mtshang btsal ba'i dus su med kyang da dung sems zhig yod pa 'dra bsam na/ dang po byung gnas 'gro gsum ngos bzung ba ni/ da ga re/ nga la shes pa zhig sngar med/ gsar du skye rgyu zhig ni yod/ bar du gnas pa'ang yod/ nga gang song na/ sems zhig yod der thon ni 'ong*/ de yang*/ mi rtag par yang 'gags 'gro tshul rnams bsam nas/ byung gnas 'gro gsum pa de yang nas yang du ngos bzung nas/ da byung sa byung mkhan/ gnas sa gnas mkhan/ 'gags sa 'gags mkhan zer bas/ dang 118)po byung mkhan sogs gsum/ blo yul can ni 'dzin pa yin/ byung sa sogs gsum ni yul yin pas/ de gnyis la gzung 'dzin gnyis yang zer/ snang sems gnyis yang zer bas/ phyi'i yul gzhi med rtsa bral dang*/ nang 'dzin pa gzhi med rtsa bral du shes na/ gzung 'dzin rang stong la 'gro dgos pas/ dang po/ byung sa sogs gsum la brtags na spyir snod bcud gnyis la brtags pa dang*/ bye brag tu dbang yul gnyis la brtags pa gnyis las/ dang po/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten la brtags pa ni/ snod bcud 'di'i rgyu ni 'byung ba rim brtsegs kyi dkyil 'khor yin pas/ 'og gzhi'i nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor ni sems kyi rlom pa tsam las ci yang grub pa med pas des na rlom pa tsam las sems byung sa med/ 119)de'i steng me'i dkyil 'khor yang*/ rdul phra rab kyi tshogs pa yin pas/ rdul de yang cha shas phyes nas nyi zer gyi rdul 'bring po tsam zhig cha bzhi bcu zhe dgu la bsal pa'i cha gcig la rdul phran cha med zer bas/
