de yang cha shas bsal na ma grub pas/ de las sems byung sa med/ de'i steng gi chu'i dkyil 'khor yang*/ rdul grub yin pas/ de yang snga ma bzhin phyogs cha dang*/ rdul dang*/ rdul phran rang bzhin med pa las/ sems byung sa med/ de'i steng gi ri'i rgyal po ri rab rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang*/ gzhan yang ri ra ba/ brag khang khyim thams cad la dang po shar/ lho/ nub/ byang sogs nas cha bsal nas dum bu byed/ de rdul du bsal/ de rdul phran cha shas rang bzhin med 120)pa'i bar du bsal bas ma grub pas/ de las sems byung sa med/ da nang bcud kyi sems can la brtags na/ sems byung sa ma rnyed de/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi sgo gsum po de las byung ba yin bsam na/ rang gzhan 'gro drug gi lus de yang dpyad na ldeb bzhi/ mgo dang lnga/ de re re bzhin du lhu tshig re re nas re re bzhin sha dang*/ rus pa dang*/ pags pa'i cha de dum bu bzhi de re re bzhin/ nang gses su phyogs cha nas phye bas/ rdul phran rang bzhin med pas/ sems byung sa ma grub/ ngag dang sems gnyis la dus gsum du brtags pas/ 'das pa 'gags zin pas sems byung sa ma grub/ ma 'ong pa ma skyes pas sems byung sa ma grub/ da lta ba skad cig gis rang yal rjes med du 'gro bas sems byung sa med par thag bcad/ gnyis 121)pa bye brag dbang yul gnyis la dpyad na/ dang po nang gi dbang po mig gi dbang po dang*/ rna ba'i dbang po dang*/ sna'i dbang po dang*/ lce'i dbang po dang*/ lus kyi dbang po dang*/ gzugs can pa lnga las sems byung pa red bsam na/ lus dpyad na ldeb/ ldeb dpyad na lhu tshig de dpyad na sha rus/ pags pa la sogs/ cha so sor dpyad na rdul phran rang bzhin gyis ma grub pas/ dper na/ pha med na bu mi skye ba bzhin du/ nang gi dbang po gzugs can pa lnga ma grub na/ yid kyi dbang po yang ma grub pas sems byung sa med/ da ni phyi yi yul gzugs dang*/ sgra dang*/

dri dang*/ ro dang*/ reg bya dang*/ blo yul la yul 'dra ba shar 'dug rgyu de chos khams yin pas/ de las sems byung ngam 122)snyams na/ phyi'i yul drug po yang dang po go brda sprad de/ mig gi mthong rgyu yod pa de la gzugs khams bya la de bzhin du rna bas thos rgyu de la sgra/ snas snoms rgyu de la dri/ lus kyi reg rgyu de la reg bya zer bas/ yul gzugs can de la dpyad tshul/ dper na/ nag tshang zhes ril po gcig tu 'dzin kyang*/ blos sgo phug steng gsum so sor phyes na/ sgo phug red zer ba las/ nag tshang ma grub sgo phug de ras zheng re re dang*/ zheng de gru gur phyes de spu nyag re re nas phyes de/ spu nyag ma re re nas phyes/ spu de dum bu so so nas phyes nas/ de rdul phran cha med/ cha med de yang dpyad nas cha shas rang bzhin med pas sems byung sa med par gtan la phab/ de nas byung mkhan 123)gyi sems kho rang yod pa zhig red bsam na/ yod pa na yod tshul zhig rnyed dgos pas/ ma rnyed na yod mi shes pa las/ byung mkhan sems de yod na/ yod tshul 'gro ba rigs drug gi gzugs zhig yod dam/ pho mo ma ning gi gzugs sam/ lha klu gnod sbyin gui gzugs yod med brtags na med/ yang na zlum po dang*/ gru bzhi dang*/ zla gam dang*/ gru gsum dang*/ phyal le ba dang*/ ngos mnyam mi mnyam dang*/ ring po dang*/ thung du la sogs pa yod med brtags na med/ yang na/ kha dogs dkar po dang*/ ser po/ dmar po dang*/ ljang gu dang*/ nag po dang*/ gnyis 'dres la sogs pa yod med brtags na ma grub la/ sems stong pa'o zhes stong 124)pas bye brag mi rung ba yin/ yang*/ ma brtags ma dpyad na/ stong pa ci yang med pa de las ci snang ba 'gogs med du sems ltar shar chog pas/ stong pa nyid sems so zer/ stong pa dang rten 'byung dbye bsal med pa chu nang gi zla ba'am me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar/ med snang stong*/

gzugs stong pa nyid las kyang sems gzhan ma yin/ sems las kyang stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin no/ zhes snang bas/ yod mtha' sel/ stong pas chad mtha' sel ba la de la dpyad 'jog spel ma byed pas/ dang po/ byung sa byung mkhan med par thag chod na/ dpyad pa rdzogs pa yin pas/ dper na/ mo gshams kyi bu dang po skye ba med pa la/ bar du gnas pa med pa dang*/ tha ma 'chi rgyu yang med pas de 125)bzhin du gnas pa gnas mkhan/ 'gro sa 'gro mkhan rang bzhin med par thag chod 'gro/ ma song na yang*/ byung sa sogs kyi dpyad pa de gnas sa gnas mkhan sogs kha spos dpyad bcug go de ltar brtags pas byung gnas 'gro gsum med pas/ stong pa med pa gsal snang gi gzugs brnyan/ snang tsam btags pa tsam la'ang byung gnas sogs yod chog pa dang*/ stong pa dang rten 'byung dbye bsal med pa'i stong nyid bzhi sbyor 'di rgyu mtshan nyid theg pa'am dbu ma chen po'i lta ba zer ba yang 'di yin pas/ 'di dang po khrid kyi dus min na/ ngo 'phrod zin rgyab yang rjes thob thams cad la brtags bcug na/ snang ba sgyu mar rtogs pa 'dis/ lag rjes las 'ong pas zab gnad che'o/ 126)༈ gnyis pa chos nyid kyi lta ba'am/ mnyam gzhag ye shes kyi lta ba ni/ yul can sems kyi gnas lugs la brtags te ye shes chen po gtan la dbab pa la/ nang gses su lta sgom spyod pa gsum pa'i/ dang po/ mnyam gzhag ye shes kyi lta ba ni/ sems babs sam gshis sam/ ngo bo sems kyi chos nyid zhes ming btags pas kyang don la sems gnas lugs de mthong dgos pa las/ de kha phyir ltas kyi dpyad pa'i shes rab kyi mi rnyed pas 'jog nas/ mnyam gzhag ye shes kyi lta ba des rtogs dgos pas/ 'jog tshul lus gnad chos bdun nam lus la zung rngu med pa drang por bzhag ngag gi gnad smra brjod spangs nas rlung rang bab la bzhag sems kyi gnad gang yang yid la mi byed/ mi lon/ len 127)mi nyan bsam dgos pa yang spang la/

rang sar bzhag rang babs la bzhag rang lugs su bzhag ma bcos par bzhag mi 'dzin par bzhag ma bsgom par bzhag ༈ kun gzhi dang cos sku'i shan 'byed ni/ dang po sems la brtags dgos pa la/ ji ltar brtags na/ mig gi ltag 'bum la bltas pa bzhin du 'dug mkhan kho rang gi ngo bo la kha nang du log te blta/ sa ra has/ ma yengs sems kyi rang gi rang la ltos/ zhes gsungs pas/ shes rab kyis brtags dus/ sems rtog med du 'dug rig pa rjen la ma bud bar rming cha can thun re re gnyis gnyis rer ci red ma go ba zhig yod rgyu de kun gzhi yin/ de 'dra ma yin pa'i go mkhan 128)tshor mkhan gyi shes pa dwangs sang nge ba yul med kyi shes pa ljon la bud pa zhig yod pa kho thag chod na de chos sku zang thal rjen pa'i ye shes bya ba yin/ 'di 'dra ba zhig ma rnyed bar du bzhag bcug nas brtags dgos la/ de 'dra ba zhig yod par thag chod dus da 'di dus gsum rtog pa e yin/ skye 'gags gnas gsum e yod/ dge mi dge'i rtog pa dang*/ bar ma'i rtog pa phra rags thams cad yin min brtags bcug pas/ rnam rtog phra rags thams cad yang min/ skye 'gags gnas gsum yang med par go na/ da rtog med zhig yin pas/ ra ro ba dang*/ brgyal ba dang*/ gnyid song ba dang kha hang song ba lta bu yang*/ ma red zer na cung zad go ba'i rtags yin/ ngo sprod mi snga bar yang yang brtags bcug 129) kun mkhyen chen pos/ khregs dang thod rgal gang la yang rtsa ba rig pa zang thal 'di rjen la 'bud shes dgos/ de ma shes na gang la sbyar yang don med gsungs pa bzhin no/ de nas sems dang rig pa'i shan 'byed de la sems mi dge ba 'dod chags sogs la/ yul med pa'i 'dod chags sogs yan gar zhig skye e shes bsam na mi shes pa'i tshul/ yid kyi yul gyi chos khams kyi yul zhes/ mig btsum nas 'dug na yid kyi ngor yul bzang po'am bud med bzang po lta bu zhig shar nas/

de la dmigs nas 'dod chags kyi blo skyes/ de bzhin du ngan pa'am dgra lta bu zhig shar bas zhe sdang skyes/ de gnyis ka ma yin pa'i yul bar ma zhig la shar ba/ de la dmigs nas gti mug gal bden 130)'dzin gyi rtog pa skyes ni red ma gtogs/ yul med kyi 'dod chags sogs shar lugs yod med brtags na med/ de bzhin du dge ba'i rtog pa dad pa dang mos gus sogs/ yul bla ma dang dkon mchog la dmigs nas skye dgos/ yul zhig la ma dmigs pas dad pa dngamos gus sogs/ skye lugs yod med brtags na med pas/ sems zhig yin nas bzung*/ yul dang yul can gnyis med na skye mi shes pas/ sems de la 'khrul pa gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog zhes bya la/ da ngo bo'i rig rjen pa de la yul yod med brtags na/ yul bzang po la dmigs nas 'dod chags kyi ngo bo ks+yes yang mi shes/ yul yang med/ de bzhin du zhe sdang la sogs pa dge ba dang mi dge ba gang gis dmigs pa'i 131)yul yang med/ zhe sdang la sogs pa dge mi dge'i nyam rtog gi ngo bor skye yang mi shes pa zhig la kho thag chod dus/ yul med kyi shes pa rbi li ma dang*/ rnam rtog gi gos kyi shub dang bral bas zang thal rjen pa'i ye shes kyang*/ de 'dra ba la zer ba yin pas zhib tu dpyang dgos/ ༈ de nas kun rdzob dang don dam gyi shan 'byed ni/ mi dge ba'i rtogs pa 'dod chag la sogs yul la brten nas sngar med pa rang rgyud la gsar du bskyed chog tshul dang*/ yang phar rang gi rgyud dang brtags gshigs chog tshul dang*/ de bzhin du dge ba'i rtog pa dad pa mos gus la sogs pa rang rgyud la sngar med gsar bskyed dang*/ phar brtags gshigs chog mi chog la brtags pas/ de ltar 132)chog pas mi rtag pa 'gyur/ rdzun pa stong yal rjes med yin pas kun rdzob bden pa yin/ da ngo bo la de ltar brtags pas yul med/ de la dmigs yang mi shes pas sngar med gsar skyes dang*/

brtags gshigs mi shes pas 'dus ma byas bden pa 'gyur med/ mi bslu ba don dam bden pa yin pas btags dgos/ de ltar rig pa de sngar med gsar skyes chog gi/ nga'i rgyud la sngar ni med pa da res ngo shes ni red zer na/ sngar med na ngo shes rgyu zhig ci la 'ong*/ sngar ngo ma shes na yang sems kyi gnas lugs sems can thams cad dang 'bral mi shes par ye nas yod pas/ sngar med gsar bskyed min/ da res ngo shes pa tsam gyis ngo shes ma shes tsam red zer dgos/ da bsgom pa ni/ de 'dra'i shes pa rbi li ma 133)rjen pa de la bzung dran 'ju dran gyi 'dzin i dgos brtags na 'dzin mi dgos par me yin dus na tsha ba yin pa dang*/ chu la rlan pa rang chas yin bzhin du/ rig pa ngo shes pa'i dus na rang bab kyi dran pa 'ju bzung mi dgos par yin min brtags bcug red zer na de la ming zhig brtags na/ chos nyid kyi dran pa dang*/ gnyug ma'i dran pa/ blo 'das kyi dran pa/ rtsol bral rang bzhag gi dran pa/ dran mchog rgyal po zhes bya ba gsug pa yin/ sems kyi bsgom pa thams cad de 'dra ma yin par bzung dran 'ju dran gyi bsgom pa zhes/ dmigs pa'i yul zhig la dmigs nas sha zung gi sha bzung ba lta bu yin par go brda sprad/ bsgom pa dngos la cog bzhag 134)chen po bzhi dang*/ mi g.yo ba sum ldan gyi sgom pa gnyis yod kyang*/ 'dir mi g.yo sum ldan bsgom pa ni/ ma bsgom na ma bsgom/ bsgom phan chad lus mi g.yo ba chos bdun ri rgyal lhun po lta bu zhes/ grol lam gyis chos bdun lhod la lhun chags pa zhig dgos la/ lus drang na rtsa drang*/ de drang na rlung drang*/ rlung drang na sems las su rung pa'i dgos pa yod pas/ dbango mi g.yo ba rgya mtsho chen po la gza' skar shar ba lta bu'i yul la sems mi spro/ nang du yang mi bsdu/ shes pa dwangs bton la bzhag sems nyid mi g.yo ba nam mkha' sprin dang bral ba'i mdang lta bu ni/

rig pa rang babs kyi bsam gtan de'i steng nas rig pa'i dwangs cha de la ma bcos par bzhag cog ger bzhag 135)lhug par bzhag mnyam par 'jog nas/ mig mi btsum pa bar snang la ha re blta/ rlung sna nas ma 'bud par kha nas dal bu'i btang la bsgom mo/ spyod pa ni/ rig pa rang gi ngo bo dge sdig gang gis phan gnod dang bral kyang*/ rtsal 'khrul pa'i ngo bo na phan gnod dang*/ rgyu 'bras thams cad yod par shes nas/ thun mong pa mthun 'jug thabs kyi spyod pa'am/ grol lam bag yod kyi spyod pa/ bla ma'i mos gus la gnad du bsnun pa/ las rgyu 'bras la blang dor gyi zhib cha phyes pa/ sdom pa dang*/ dam tshig mig gi 'bras bu bzhin du bsrung ba/ tshogs bsags sgrib sbyang la 'bad rgyu bzhi la 'dus par gsung*/ thun mong ma yin pa rdzogs chen rang lam gyi 136)spyod pa ni/ mi rgan pos byis pa'i rtsed mo la lta ba bzhin du/ grol pa'i rig pa chos sku ngos bzung nas/ 'khrul pa'i sems rnam par rtog pa thams cad chu'i rlabs chu la thim pa ltar rang gsal rjes med du skyong ba yin no/ rtsa ba'i gnyis pa/ dngos gzhi rig pa rang ngo sprad pa la/ sprad bya ngos bzung ba/ sprad tshul shan phyes pa/ rig pa chos sku ngo sprad pa gsum las/ sprad bya ngos bzung ba ni/ sems can gyi rgyud na/ bde gshegs snying po sku dang ye shes yon tan thams cad ma bcos lhun grub kyi tshul du bzhugs yod pa'i ye shes dri ma dang bcas pa/ skabs kyi ye shes de ngo sprad bya yin la/ sprad tshul shan phye ba ni/ sngon dpyad 'jog gi gnas skabs na/ rtog med yengs 'khrul dang bral ba'i rmong cha can 137)de kun gzhi yin/ rig pa chos sku ni/ tha mal gyi shes pa bzo bcos dang bral ba rba li ma yul la ma ltos pa'i dwangs cha can de chos sku yin/ rig pa chos sku ngo sprad pa ni/ de lta bu'i rig pa de la ming zhig btags na/ rig pa rjen pa chos sku thig le nyag cig gal lhag pa'i chos sku chen por zer/

de la dbye na gzhi'i chos sku ni/ blo bur gyi dri ma dang bcas pa'i skabs de yin/ lam gyi chos sku ni/ rnal 'byor pas lam dus su gnas lugs ci rigs par rtogs pa yin/ 'bras bus chos sku ni/ 'bras bu sgrib bral gyi dus na dag pa gnyis ldan gyi sangs rgyas yin/ sku gsum du ngo sprad na/ gnas lugs de nyid dbyibs dang mtshan ma la sogs pa ngo 138)bo dang ngos bzung med pa'i stong cha de ni chos sku yin/ stong pa phyad du song ba ma yin pa stong pa rig pa'i snying po can gyi gsal cha de longs sku yin/ de gnyis zung du 'jug pa nang gsal gyi thugs rje cha de sprul pa'i sku yin/ da gang shar chos sku'i rol rtsal du ngo sprad pa na/ kun rdzob kyi chos yod do cog thams cad po rig pa chos sku chen po de'i rtsal rol pa/ che ba'i rgyan/ gzhi snang lhun grub kyi snang ba yin pas na/ gnas lugs ye shes chen po de/ rang gzhan gnyis ka'i lus ltar du snang ba ni/ rgyal ba'i sku rdo rje yin/ de'i rang gdangs a l̥ sogs dbyangs dang*/ ka l̥ sogs gsal byed dbyings ye zung 'jug gi gdangs ngag ltar du grags pa ni/ rgyal ba'i gsung rdo rje yin/ rig pa'i 139)rtsal sogs rang gzhan gyi yid du 'phro ba ni/ rgyal ba'i thugs rdo rje yin/ mdor na gnas lugs ye shes chen po de'i rtsal rol pa 'char tshul/ che ba'i rgyan du phyi snod kyi 'jig rten ltar snang ba ni/ 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi zhing khams dag pa rab 'byams yin/ rang bzhin gyi lus ngag yid gsum ltar na rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin/ dper na/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs ye shes chen po'i rtsal sogs zhing khams dang rdo rje gsum du shar ba dang*/ rang gi rig pa ye shes kyi 'char tshul la/ ye shes rang gi ngo bo la/ bzang ngan med par thag bcad la/ ngo sprad la nges shes 'drongs nges dgos/ de dag gis gnad bsdus na/ slob dpon chen po dga' rab rdo

140)rjes/ ngo rang thog tu sprad pa/ thag gcig thog ta bcad pa/ gdengs grol thog tu bca' ba gsum du 'du bas/ dang po/ ngo rang thog tu sprad pa ni/ lta ba'i khrid kha tshang de nyid yin/ gnyis pa/ nyi ma de ring nas dbang zhus tshad thams cad gnas lugs las log na med par thag bcad/ 'di ni tshig dbang yin no/ dam tshig thams cad log na med par thag bcad/ 'di ni ye srung chen po'i dam tshig yin/ lta ba thams cad 'di las log na med par thag bcad/ 'di ni phyag rdzogs dbu gsum thams cad rdzogs pa chen po rtogs pa yin/ lam skyabs 'gro yin/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs chos sku chen po yin/ chos la lam 'gogs gnyis las/ lam bden dpyad pa yin/ 141)'gogs bden gnas lugs yin/ dge 'dun la rig grol gnyis las/ rig pa yin/ grol ba yin pas/ dkon mchog gsum yin par thag bcad/ rang rig ye shes bla ma yin/ chos nyid don gyi lha yin/ chos nyid kyi mkha' la thugs rje rnam rtog shar grol 'gags med du 'gro ba'i mkha' 'gro yang yin par thag bcad/ bskyed rim thams cad ye shes las log na med par thag bcad do/ gsum pa/ gdengs grol thog tu bca' ba ni/ grol ba ngos 'dzin dgos/ gnas lugs ye shes chen po grol pa yin/ kho rang gi ngo bo la grol 'khrul med/ rtsal 'khrul pa'i steng nas grol 'khrul brtsi dgos/ rnam rtogs 'phro 'thud med par zhig 142)'gro na grol ba yin/ 'khrul pa zhig dag chad/ grol zer ba rnams don gcig rnam rtog rgya 'byams la shor na 'khrul pa zer bas/ grol lugs la/ nge shes rtsal rdzogs brtan pa thob pa zhes/ ngo ma shes na 'og 'gyu'i 'phrang mi chod/ rtsal ma rdzogs na rkyen ngan mi 'khyogs/ brtan pa ma thob na rnal 'byor ba min/ dang po dug lnga gang skyes ngos bzung zin na grol 'gro/ ngos bzung zhing rtsal rdzogs nas las ma bsags pa'i gong la grol dgos pa las/ de la ma grol na/ brtan pa ma thob pa yin pas/

nyon mongs sa la gnyen por brten nas spong dgos/ rang lugs la/ nyon mongs mi spang*/ mi sgyur/ lam du mi byed par/ gnas lugs chen 143)po gcig bskyang bas/ 'khrul pa thams cad nam mkhar dwangs pa'am lan tshwa chu la thim pa ltar grol 'gro bas/ de lta bu'i lta ba rtogs/ bsgom pa goms/ spyod pas bog dbyung bas/ rab lus rdul phran du dengs/ sems chos nyid du grol/ 'bring nyi zla'i 'char nub ltar/ bar do la grol/ tha ma yang rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing dang*/ yang na skye ba phyi ma la grol nas sangs rgyas thob nges pa can yin pa las/ brtson pas nyams su blang bar 'tshal lo/ gsum pa/ rjes nyams kyi bskyong tshul bstan pa la gsum las/ nyams rtogs shan 'byed pa/ la zla ba/ rang grol du lam du khyer ba gsum gyi/ dang po la/ klong chen pas/ nyams dang rtogs 144)pa'i dbye ba ma shes na/ goms pa'i nyams la rtogs par 'dzin te 'khrul/ rtogs na dus kun nam yang 'pho 'gyur med/ de nyid goms pas yon tan nyams rnams 'byung*/ snying nas mi rtag blo sna thung ba dang*/ dag snang mos gus phyogs med 'char ba dang*/ byams dang snying rje rgyun chad med par 'byung*/ zhes gsung pas/ dang po ni/ lus ngag gnyis la sngon gyi las ngan pa dang*/ da lta'i bsgom pa'i skabs kyis rlung sems ngan pa re 'du tshul gyis lus nad kyis mnar ba dang*/ gdon gyis zin pa dang*/ ngag dig pa dang*/ lkugs pa la sogs pa mi 'dod pa du ma 'byung ba yang na las dang rlung sems bzang po re 'du tshul gyis lus kyis rdzu 'phrul dang*/ grub rtag bstan pa dang*/ ngag gis 'gro ba 145)rigs drug gi skad smra shes pa la sogs pa bzang po yang 'byung la/ sems la snang nyams dang shes nyams gnyis las/ snang nyams bzang po bla ma dang yi dam gyi zhal gzigs pa dang*/ ma dang mkha' 'gros lung ston pa dang*/ sku dang thig le brda yig dang*/ ngan pa chags sdang lha 'dre dang rgyal 'gong gis cho 'phrul du ma snang nyams/

shes nyams bzang po bde gsal mi rtogs gsum gyis nyams skyes/ ngan pa chags sdang rmongs gsum dang*/ rnam rtog ngan pa gnyen pos mi non pa 'dra ba re skyes 'ong*/ rtogs pa tha mal gyi shes pa zad thal rjen la bud pa gnyis shan legs par phyes nas brtags bcug ༈ gnyis pa/ nyams rtogs la zla ba ni/ nyams bzang po shar 146)yang zhen rgyu med pa/ ngan par shar kyang zhen rgyu med par ro mnyam du thag chod pa zhig la gsungs pas/ da nyams bzang ngan dang sngar gyi bcos ma blos byas kyi/ lta bsgom spyod pa thams cad phar ded tshur ded byas nas/ bzang ngan med par shes dgos pas/ dper na/ rgya mtsho la rlabs 'phyo ba dang*/ rlabs de nyid rgya mtsho'am rang gi 'char tshul la/ cho 'phrul dang*/ rnam rol/ rnam 'gyur yin pas/ phar ded na/ ye shes kyi rtsal yin pas/ bzang ngan med pas/ tshur ded na/ rang ngo las 'das pa sa med pas chu dang rlabs gnyis po ngo bo gcig pa ltar bzang ngan med par thag bcad/ de bzhin du/ gang la'ang bzang ngan gyi zhen pa yod rigs la zhen pa thams cad de bzhin du dpyad dgos/ gsum pa ni/ 147)nyams rtogs rang grol du lam du khyer tshul/ nyams rtogs dang po shan 'byed cing la bzlas zin pa dang mnyam du dben pa yin na/ lus bca' bshigs pa la stag mo 'phyong stabs/ gyad kyi 'dor thabs/ song go 'phags stangs bya/ mig gi lta stangs/ steng dang*/ 'og dang*/ g.yas g.yon la sogs pa la 'phar 'phrul tshur 'phrul gyis lta ba dang*/ ngag gi brjod pa thabs shes kyi yi ge phaṭa drag po zhig nyams ngan gyi zhen pa de'i ngo la rgyab/ sems kyis bsgom blo bor ba/ khyed kyi sgom gyi 'dzin pa de/ shig la thongs/ khrol pa thongs/ phyes la thongs bsam nas sgom la bdag po sprad nas 'dzin rgyu de bshigs pas/ nyams zhig shul du de na rig pa gsal sang nge ba zhig 148)yod rgyu de mi g.yo gsum ldan gyis bsgom/ jo bo rjes/ ka ra yul la bcings pa yis/

rtogs pa'i 'gyu ba gcod par byed/ lta stangs snga phyi brje ba yis/ byin rgod thun skyon sel bar byed/ gnyen po'i rtsol ba bshigs pa yis/ gnyug ma rang la 'khor bar byed/ ces so/ ༈ da ni lhun grub thod rgal gyi gnad cung zad 'bri na/ thabs thod rgal gyis drangs pa'i thabs byung*/ shes rab rang byung gi sgron ma ka dag gi lta ba rang rgyud la 'dren pa ni/ thod rgal gyis dgos pa dang*/ der ma zad/ 'ja' lus 'pho chen grub pa dang*/ min kyang bar do lhun grub kyi snang ba la grol chad bshad pa rnams/ thod rgal goms pa'i lag rjes las byung bas/ de la/ sngon 'gro 149)dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum las/ dang po la/ ru shan dang*/ sgo gsum sbyong ba gnyis kyi dang po la/ lus ngag yid gsum gyis ru shan so sor byed pa dang*/ mnyam du byed pa'i phyag len gnyis yod kyang*/ 'khor 'das kyi bya ba gang la yang*/ sgo gsum chun gcig dril gyis byed pa yin pas ru shan zhes bya ba/ sgo gsum zhes bya ba/ zhen pa dang bcas pa 'khor ba'i ru'am phyogs yin la/ zhen pa med pa myang 'das kyi ru'am phyogs yin pas/ zhen pa mchod bar du sbyong dogs pa yin la/ sbyong tshul ni/ dben pa'i gnas su song*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gis lus ngag yid gsum ru shan phyes nas phyin chad 'khor bar mi ldog par bya'o bsams nas/ 150)byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ de nas lus gcer bur phyung nas/ khrus byas/ mar gyi phye phur gyi sku mnyes par bya/ aṃ rag gsol/ sngon 'gro bla ma rgyang 'bod sogs nas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang bzhi blang ba'i bar du byas nas/ de nas gzhi bdag la dkar gtor dang*/ sde brgyad la gser skyems btang la/ de nas/ ka ye pha ri g.yas la gnas pa'i snang zhing srid pa'i sde brgyad 'byung po thams cad dang*/ tshur ri g.yon la gnas pa/ gangs ri dkar la gnas pa/ srib ri nag la gnas pa/ skye ba shing la gnas pa/

gor mo rdo la gnas pa/ 'bab pa chu la gnas pa/ 'gro ba lam la gnas pa'i snang zhing srid pa'i sde brgyad 'byung po thams cad nyon cig bdag rnal 'byor pa ming 'di zhes bya 151)bas gnas 'di na sems can thams cad kyi don du 'khor 'das ru shan spyod par byed pa yin pas/ khyed rnams kyis/ ko long dang*/ ru nga dang*/ phrag dgos ma byed cig ces phrin las bcol lo/ de nas lus kyi rgyugs pa dang*/ 'gro ba dang*/ 'phyongs ba dang*/ nyal ba dang*/ langs pa dang*/ 'dril ba dang*/ 'gre ldog byed pa dang*/ spyi tshugs dang*/ gan rkyal dang*/ kha sbubs dang*/ gog te 'gro ba la sogs pa yid la dran tshad bya la/ de nas ngag gis dmyal ba'i a tsha a na'i du 'bod dang*/ kyi hud dang*/ 'o dod 'bod pa dang*/ ngu ba dang*/ smre sngags 'don pa dang*/ yi dwags kyi 'khun sgra dang*/ dud 'gro'i rigs kyi 'ba' sgra sna tshogs dang*/ mi rgya bod kyi skad sna 152)tshogs dang*/ lha ma yin sod sod chod chod rgyob rgyob la sogs pa dang*/ lha'i glu len pa dang*/ bro brdung ba'i tshigs dang*/ ki sgra dang*/ bswo sgra dang*/ cha sgra la sogs pa yid la shar tshad brjod par bya/ sems kyi 'gro ba rigs drug gis sdug bsngal dang*/ bde snang yid la glo bur du bslang la bsams nas/ zhag nyer gcig gam/ lo rer zla ba gsum du byas na/ 'khor ba la zhen pa log myang 'das la thob 'dod kyi blo bcos ma ma yin pa ma skyes bar du sbyang*/ bi ma las/ lo rer zla ba drug re sbyong bar gsung pas mtshon no/ ༈ de nas nang gi ru shan rang gi lus 'di grub tsam na/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi sa bon spyi bo/ mgrin pa/ snying ka lte ba/ gsang gnas/ rkang mthil gnyis 153)rnams su rim pa bzhin du aḥsuḥnṛḥtriḥpreḥduḥrnams su/ rigs drugs rang rang gi bag chags kyi rang 'od dang bcas pa'i steng*/ sbyong byed rgyal ba thams cad kyi sku rdo rje'i ngo bor spyi bo na oṃ yig dkar po las 'od zer 'phro ba dang*/

mgrin par/ gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo āḥyig dmar po/ snying gar/ thugs rje'i ngo bo hūṃ yig mthing ga rnams las 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros te/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi sa bon bag chags dang bcas pa rang bzhin med par thul gyis sbyangs par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes/ 'bru gsum 'bum phrag bdun bzlas/ ༈ de nas lus ngag yid gsum sbyang ba ni/ thal 'gyur rtsa rgyud las/ rdo rje skyil krung rab bcas te/ lus sbyang sems la phan pa yin/ zhes gsungs pas/ lang te rkang pa'i mthil gnyis sprad de rting pa gsang bar gtad/ lus kyi cha bsrings/ lag pa gnyis mgo bo la ma reg par spyi bor thal mo sbyar/ rdo rje sngon po me rab tu 'bar ba gcig tu bsgom la/ dang po/ lus na ba nas mthar bde drod ma skyes bar du sbyangs/ lus kyi zhen pa ldog bar chad zhi/ sdig pa dag pa'i dgos pa yod do/ ngag sbyangs ba la bzhi/ rgyas gdab pa la ni/ phyi snang ba la rgyas gdab pa ni/ hūṃ zhes sgra che chung ran par dbyangs dang bcas pa bzlas pa'i dus su/ rang gi sna bug g.yas nas hūṃ mang po gcig gi steng la gcig thon nas/ sa phyogs dang snang ba thams cad hūṃ gis me re re kheng par bsam mo/ 155)nang po rgyas gdab pa ni/ hūṃ zhes pas/ phyi rol gyi hūṃ rnams gcig byung gnyis byung sna bug g.yon gi nang du zhugs nas lus kun hūṃ gis me re re gang bar bsam mo/ gnyis pa rtsal sbyang ba ni/ hūṃ sgra drag tu brjod pas/ rang gi snying ka nas hūṃ mthing nag mtho gang pa me lce dang bcas te/ mang por song*/ snang ba'i dngos po thams cad phar thal tshur thal du khol tshe med par phug par bsam/ yang hūṃ gis nang gi rang lus khol tshe med par phug par bsam la hūṃ ngar bskyed nas brjod do/ gsum pa gnyen btsal ba ni/ mdun du shing la sogs par hūṃ gis phreng ba brgyus pa bzhin du song nas/ shing bu la sogs pa'i rtsa'i rtse mo'i bar du phar kri yang*/

rtse mo tshur 156)zhig nas rang gi snying gar bsdu/ de gnyis res mos su bsam la hūṃ brjod do/ bzhi pa lam du zhugs pa ni/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum hūṃ mthing nag gru gang par bsam la/ 'gro myong ma myong ba'i lam thams cad du phar 'phags tshur 'phags kyis 'gro bar bsam la hūṃ brjod/ 'di rnam shes rlung zhon gyi 'pho ba yin pas da lta nas goms dgos gnyis pa/ dngos gzhi la/ thod rgal gyi snang ba dbyings rnam dag gi sgron ma zhing khams su smin/ thig le stong pa'i sgron ma gzhal yas khang du smin/ rig gdangs rdo rje lu gu rgyud skur smin/ shes rab rang byung gi sgron ma thugs chos skur smin nas sangs rgyas 'grub pa yang gsang bla na med kyi khyad chos yin pas gnad shes par byas nas/ sngon du 157)lus ngag yid gsum gyi gnad gzir/ gnad gsum la brten nas/ mngon sum rang thog tu dbab pa/ nyams su blang pas snang ba bzhi'i 'char tshul la gsum las/ dang po lus gnad/ bzhugs stangs gsum gyi gang rung*/ ngag gi gnad/ smra ba bcad pa dang*/ yid kyi gnad/ dran bsam 'phro 'du dang bral bar bslabs so/ gnyis pa ni/ bsgom pa'i gnad/ gzigs stangs gsum gang rung*/ las dang po pa las/ sprul sku'i gzigs stangs mig phyed btsum tsam gyi zim bus blta/ yum gyi gnad/ nam mkha' sprin dang bral ba la gtad nas/ rlung rig gi gnad/ rlung kha nas dal bus btang bar bya/ rig pa ma yengs par 158)mnyam par bzhag nyi ma'i 'og khru gang gis sar nyi zer la blta/ zla ba'i dkyil du blta/ mar me'i rtse mor blta/ dang po/ dbyings rnam dag gi sgron ma thig le gnyis gshog pa sdoms pa yi ge na ro lta bu nas/ dbyings 'ja' tshon du smin/ de'i nang du thig le stong pa'i sgron ma ni/ rgya mig gam go mgo rdo bskur ba'i rjes su lta bu'i 'od zer lnga'i mu khyud can gyi thig le mang po dbyings rnam dag gi sgron ma la phra btab pa ltar 'char/

rig pa rdo rje lu gu rgyud gser gyi skud pa lding ba lta bu'am/ lug rgyud kyi rgyu ma phus btab pa ltar/ 'gro 'ong dang bcas pa shar dus/ dbyings rnam dag gi sgron ma'i nang du thig le stongs pa'i sgron ma shar ba'i dbus su mig gi tsham tshum mi byed 159)par zim mer blta ba dang*/ nang shes rab rang byung gi sgron ma/ ka dag gi rig pa chos sku zang thal gyi ye shes la/ ma bcos par mnyam par bzhag nas bsgom rgyu las gzhan med/ goms pas na nyi ma mi dgos par skar khung lta bu'i rkyen ci rig pa mnyam par bzhag mtshan mo mun khang lta bu la'ang rtsol ba med par 'char ro/ de ltar ma shar bar du bsgom mo/ gsum pa/ nyams su blang bas/ snang ba bzhi'i 'char tshul ni/ dang po/ tshogs lam chos nyid mngon sum gyis dus su/ dbyings snang dang po mthong ba nas bzung*/ 'od dang thig le la sogs pa shar nas/ thig le stongs sgron sum 'brel du 'char bar rnams so/ gnyis pa/ sbyor lam 160)nyams gong 'phel gyi skabs/ 'od snang rtsibs shar dang*/ gyen 'greng dang*/ drwa phyed dang*/ za 'og ris la sogs pa thams cad ye shes lnga'i gdangs bsam gyis mi khyab par 'char/ gsum pa/ mthong lam ma dag pa bdun rig pa tshad phebs/ sku dang*/ zhing khams su snang*/ rig pa rang thog tu phebs pas rtsol sgrub byar mi dgos lags/ longs sku'i snang ba la spyod/ nga bdag 'dzin pa thams cad nub/ mngon shes dang*/ rdzu 'phrul thams cad la rang dbang du bsgyur bas 'phags pa'i yon tan thob pa yin no/ bzhi pa/ dag pa gsum chos nyid zad pa ni/ phyi sa rdo zad pa ni ri brag nang sgyu lus kyi rdos bcas/ gsang ba rnam rtog gi 'phro 'du'i snang ba thams cad gang yang zad 161)nas nyi ma sprin pa dang bral ba la rang gsal ba de bzhin du/ thugs rje ye shes kyi snang ba rgyun mi 'chad par snang ba yin no/ gsum pa rjes mtha' brten gyi man ngag khrid rgyas par sngar nas phul zin pa'i dbang du byas pa lags/

de ltar yang dag man ngag snying po'i don/ nyams len gnad bsdus gsang ba'i yi ge 'di/ rkun po'i nor bzhin rang gi snying la sba/ khyad par bsgrags pa'i 'os su 'di mi rung*/ gong ma'i man ngag yi ge grangs mang yang*/ tshig nyun don 'dril nyams su blang bde ba/ bla ma'i lug la brten pa'i yig chung 'dis/ khyed kyi don du 'gyur snyams 'bad pa yin/ deng sang snyigs ma bdo ba'i yang mtha' 'dir/ zab mo bshad pas phan pa nyung na yang*/ 162)sbyang pa'i 'phro can rigs kyi bu mo la/ thugs la 'thad dam snyams nas bshad pa yin/ khyod nyid zhi ba'i nags su dengs dga' bas/ sman shing me tog chu gtsang brag ri'i dgos/ nags tshal dpal gyis brgyan pa der phyin nas/ gcig pu zab mo'i ting 'dzin bsgoms bar shog mtho ris lha lam skyed tshal ches lhag pa'i/ sngon byon drang srong gis brten dben pa'i ngogs/ tshe gang thar pa'i byang chub la reg nas/ 'phrin las mkha' khyab gdul bya'i dpal du shog nam mkha'i rang bzhin gzhon nu bum pa'i sku/ nang gsal sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med/ dus gsum mi 'gyur chos sku bde klong 'khyil/ rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog zhes pa'ang las dang skal ba ldan 163)pa bu mo bsam gtan sgron ma'i thugs dam nyams kyi gsal 'debs su/ bskur ba don yod par bgyid pa po nu/ chos smra ba'i btsun pa 'od gsal rin chen snying po padma las 'brel rtsal gyis sug bris su bltar nas phul ba dge legs su gyur cig sarba dwā ka lya naṃ bha wantu//
